slots.claim_sentence: Researchers studied a new mouse missense variant called Rasgrp1Anaef.
slots.clarification_sentence: This variant has a mutation in the Rasgrp1 Ras guanine nucleotide exchange factor.

slots.claim_sentence: Rasgrp1Anaef mice develop anti-nuclear autoantibodies and specific CD4+ T cell populations.
slots.clarification_sentence: The accumulation of these Helios+ PD-1+ T cells is dependent on B cells.

slots.claim_sentence: CD44 is overexpressed on naïve thymocytes and T cells in Rasgrp1Anaef mice.
slots.clarification_sentence: This change occurs despite reduced Rasgrp1-Ras-ERK activation in laboratory tests.

slots.claim_sentence: Thymocyte selection in these mutant mice remains mostly normal in vivo.
slots.clarification_sentence: The overexpression of CD44 happens in a T-cell-autonomous manner.

slots.claim_sentence: CD44 expression is a sensitive reporter of tonic mTOR-S6 kinase signaling.
slots.clarification_sentence: This was identified using a novel mouse strain called chino.

slots.claim_sentence: The chino strain carries a reduction-of-function mutation in the Mtor gene.
slots.clarification_sentence: This strain helps track small changes in basal mTOR activity.

slots.claim_sentence: Elevated tonic mTOR-S6 signaling occurs in Rasgrp1Anaef naïve CD4+ T cells.
slots.clarification_sentence: This signaling increase is a key feature of the missense variant.

slots.claim_sentence: Increased mTOR activity is essential for the Rasgrp1Anaef T cell dysregulation.
slots.clarification_sentence: Reducing mTOR function in double-mutant mice returned immune markers to normal.

slots.claim_sentence: Serum autoantibodies and T cell ratios returned to normal in these mice.
slots.clarification_sentence: The Rasgrp1AnaefMtorchino mice showed that mTOR drives the observed immune problems.

slots.claim_sentence: Mutations in the SWI/SNF chromatin remodeling family are common in many types of cancer.
slots.clarification_sentence: The SWI/SNF complex is a group of proteins that reorganize how DNA is packed.

slots.claim_sentence: The mechanisms by which these protein components alter tumor growth remain poorly understood.
slots.clarification_sentence: Tumorigenesis is the process by which normal cells transform into cancerous tumor cells.

slots.claim_sentence: Researchers studied pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma by suppressing a specific subunit called Arid1a in mice.
slots.clarification_sentence: This mouse model allowed for the inducible and reversible suppression of the Arid1a protein.

slots.claim_sentence: The study combined Arid1a suppression with the activation of the oncogenic KrasG12D gene.
slots.clarification_sentence: Oncogenic KrasG12D is a mutated gene known to drive the development of pancreatic cancer.

slots.claim_sentence: Silencing Arid1a in the adult pancreas caused acinar cells to become mucinous precursor lesions.
slots.clarification_sentence: Acinar cells are specialized pancreatic cells that normally produce and secrete digestive enzymes.

slots.claim_sentence: This reprogramming of adult pancreatic cells into cancer precursors was rapid and irreversible.
slots.clarification_sentence: The cells could not return to their normal state even after Arid1a was restored.

slots.claim_sentence: Arid1a silencing during embryogenesis led to the retention of the normal acinar cell fate.
slots.clarification_sentence: Embryogenesis is the early stage of development before the mouse is born.

slots.claim_sentence: Arid1a acts as a critical modulator of Kras-dependent changes in acinar cell identity.
slots.clarification_sentence: The protein helps control whether cells keep their identity or turn into cancer.

slots.claim_sentence: The timing and genetic context influence how SWI/SNF complex alterations affect epithelial tumorigenesis.
slots.clarification_sentence: Epithelial tumorigenesis refers to the formation of tumors in the lining of organs.

slots.claim_sentence: Malaria infection begins when Plasmodium sporozoites are injected into the skin by an Anopheles mosquito.
slots.clarification_sentence: These parasites must travel through the skin to reach the blood circulation of the host.

slots.claim_sentence: How sporozoites locate and enter a blood vessel is a critical but poorly understood process.
slots.clarification_sentence: The parasites must penetrate blood vessels to exit the skin and continue the infection.

slots.claim_sentence: This study used intravital microscopy in mice to examine sporozoite motility and dermal blood vessels.
slots.clarification_sentence: Researchers used P. berghei sporozoites expressing a fluorescent protein to track movement in the ear.

slots.claim_sentence: Plasmodium sporozoites exhibit two types of motility depending on their distance from blood vessels.
slots.clarification_sentence: The parasites show fast avascular motility far from vessels and more constrained movement nearby.

slots.claim_sentence: The curvature of sporozoite tracks engaging with vasculature optimizes contact with dermal capillaries.
slots.clarification_sentence: Many parasites glide in circular paths that match the circumference of the small blood vessels.

slots.claim_sentence: Imaging sporozoites with mutations in adhesive proteins showed the importance of gliding speed.
slots.clarification_sentence: The ability to modulate adhesive properties is essential for the parasite to exit the inoculation site.

slots.claim_sentence: Mutant sporozoites with slower speeds have a significantly decreased chance to encounter and invade vessels.
slots.clarification_sentence: A reduction in speed reduces the area of tissue the parasite can explore for entry.

slots.claim_sentence: The average speed of gliding sporozoites decreases significantly once they approach a blood vessel.
slots.clarification_sentence: This change in speed helps the parasite transition from searching to interacting with the vessel.

slots.claim_sentence: The lineages slowly reach over 90% fitness of their BEM1 ancestors.

slots.claim_sentence: Sequencing genomes and monitoring polarization reveals a common evolutionary trajectory.
slots.clarification_sentence: The yeast followed a predictable path to restore their health.

slots.clarification_sentence: Cells survive even when a major part is missing.

slots.claim_sentence: Neurobiologists have traditionally studied decisions by offering successive, independent choices between goods or gambles.
slots.clarification_sentence: These simple choices often provide one-off rewards without further consequences.

slots.claim_sentence: Many real-world choices, such as investing in a house, have lasting consequences.
slots.clarification_sentence: These decisions require long-term commitment to a prospect for sustained economic return.

slots.claim_sentence: Humans decided whether to commit to prospects that provided sustained financial return.
slots.clarification_sentence: Participants could choose acceptance, rejection, or deferral of the financial commitment.

slots.claim_sentence: BOLD signals in the rostral medial prefrontal cortex encoded stimulus value during deferral.
slots.clarification_sentence: This rmPFC activity suggests a role in integrating value signals over time.

slots.claim_sentence: The dorsal anterior cingulate cortex encoded stimulus value only when participants rejected prospects.
slots.clarification_sentence: This dACC region also tracked value when participants deferred accepting an offer.

slots.claim_sentence: The dACC BOLD signals reflected a bias to weight potential losses more heavily.
slots.clarification_sentence: This bias and the tendency to defer commitments actually maximised reward in this task.

slots.claim_sentence: These findings offer fresh insights into the pressures that shape economic decisions.
slots.clarification_sentence: The results clarify the computation of value in the medial prefrontal cortex.

slots.claim_sentence: Choosing a partner is another example of a choice with lasting consequences.
slots.clarification_sentence: Future changes of mind in these scenarios often incur significant penalties.

slots.claim_sentence: The dACC activity revealed a specific tendency to defer commitments until later.
slots.clarification_sentence: Weighting unfavorable options more heavily also helped shape these economic decisions.

slots.claim_sentence: Paraspeckles are nuclear bodies that form around the long non-coding RNA Neat1.
slots.clarification_sentence: These structures also contain several different RNA-binding proteins within the cell nucleus.

slots.claim_sentence: Paraspeckles control gene expression by retaining specific mRNA molecules inside the nucleus.
slots.clarification_sentence: This nuclear retention involves mRNA containing inverted repeats of Alu sequences called IRAlu.

slots.claim_sentence: In pituitary cells, all paraspeckle components displayed a daily circadian expression pattern.
slots.clarification_sentence: This rhythmic pattern included the Neat1 RNA and four major paraspeckle proteins.

slots.claim_sentence: Adding IRAlu to EGFP cDNA caused rhythmic circadian nuclear retention of egfp mRNA.
slots.clarification_sentence: This rhythmic retention of the mRNA was lost when the paraspeckles were disrupted.

slots.claim_sentence: Real-time video-microscopy showed that IRAlu drove the circadian expression of EGFP protein.
slots.clarification_sentence: The IRAlu sequences were responsible for the daily rhythmic levels of this protein.

slots.claim_sentence: Paraspeckles control circadian gene expression at a post-transcriptional level through their own rhythm.
slots.clarification_sentence: The study confirms that these nuclear bodies regulate daily cycles of gene activity.

slots.claim_sentence: The IRAlu sequences are located in the 3'-UTR region of the messenger RNA.
slots.clarification_sentence: Nuclear retention prevents these specific mRNA molecules from being translated into proteins.

slots.claim_sentence: The number of paraspeckles within the nucleus changed over the course of a day.
slots.clarification_sentence: The levels of these components fluctuated in a daily, circadian rhythm.

slots.claim_sentence: Presynaptic calcium channel function is critical for converting electrical information into chemical communication.
slots.clarification_sentence: These channels operate in a specific area of the neuron called the active zone.

slots.claim_sentence: The active-zone protein Munc13 controls the function of presynaptic voltage-gated calcium channels.
slots.clarification_sentence: Munc13 dictates how these channels behave during various forms of neuronal activity.

slots.claim_sentence: Munc13 interacts with these channels via two basic residues in its C2B domain.
slots.clarification_sentence: This specific interaction was demonstrated through laboratory tests performed in vitro.

slots.claim_sentence: Removing Munc13 alters how calcium channels respond to high-frequency action potential bursts.
slots.clarification_sentence: Using a Munc13 C2B mutant also changes the calcium influx from single stimuli.

slots.claim_sentence: Munc13 impacts information transfer by controlling vesicle priming and the trigger for exocytosis.
slots.clarification_sentence: This discovery illustrates a novel form of modulation at the nerve terminals.

slots.claim_sentence: The molecules that shape calcium channel function in the active zone are poorly understood.
slots.clarification_sentence: Understanding these molecules is essential for learning how neurons communicate.

slots.claim_sentence: Munc13 is an active-zone protein that is essential for the process of exocytosis.
slots.clarification_sentence: Exocytosis is the method neurons use to release chemical signals.

slots.claim_sentence: Eliminating the Munc13 interaction changes the recovery of channels after rapid electrical bursts.
slots.clarification_sentence: This change affects how reliably a synapse can send repeated signals.

slots.claim_sentence: Many plants have puzzle-shaped cells in their outer layer called the epidermis.
slots.clarification_sentence: The functional benefit of these complex cell shapes has remained elusive.

slots.claim_sentence: These intricate forms may provide a strategy to reduce mechanical stress.
slots.clarification_sentence: This reduction in stress occurs specifically within the cell wall.

slots.claim_sentence: Lobes emerge when tissue-level growth is isotropic or uniform in all directions.
slots.clarification_sentence: These lobes prevent large isodiametric cells from bulging under internal turgor pressure.

slots.claim_sentence: Data from various plant organs and species support this growth isotropy relationship.
slots.clarification_sentence: The researchers tested this by using mutants where growth direction was perturbed.

slots.claim_sentence: Simulation models show that actively regulating cellular stress reproduces the cell shape.
slots.clarification_sentence: These models mimic the development of the epidermal cell shape.

slots.claim_sentence: Mechanical stress is a key driver of cell-shape morphogenesis in plants.
slots.clarification_sentence: This finding explains how physical forces help determine the final cell form.

slots.claim_sentence: Reducing stress potentially lowers the amount of material required for cell walls.
slots.clarification_sentence: The cell wall maintains mechanical integrity with less cellulose and other materials.

slots.claim_sentence: Organs with uniform growth have puzzle shapes while elongated organs have fewer lobes.
slots.clarification_sentence: Genetic changes that modify growth anisotropy result in the predicted cell shapes.

slots.claim_sentence: Most human genes contain multiple introns that must be removed to define exons.
slots.clarification_sentence: Spliceosomes are the molecular machines that ensure these exons connect properly.

slots.claim_sentence: Human spliceosome assembly involves both cross-intron interactions and cross-exon interactions.
slots.clarification_sentence: It was previously unclear how these two types of interactions work together.

slots.claim_sentence: Researchers used CoSMoS to observe single pre-mRNA molecules in human nuclear extracts.
slots.clarification_sentence: This method uses fluorescently tagged spliceosomal subcomplexes to track dynamic molecular interactions.

slots.claim_sentence: The U1 subcomplex bound to one 5' splice site acts with another U1.
slots.clarification_sentence: This joint action dramatically increases the rate and efficiency of U2 subcomplex recruitment.

slots.claim_sentence: The U2 subcomplex is recruited to the branch site/3' splice site of the upstream intron.
slots.clarification_sentence: This recruitment is essential for the early stages of the splicing process.

slots.claim_sentence: The flanking 5' splice sites have greater than additive effects on U2 recruitment.
slots.clarification_sentence: These results imply that distinct mechanisms facilitate the recruitment of the U2 subcomplex.

slots.claim_sentence: Synergy of 5' splice sites across introns and exons promotes correct and efficient splicing.
slots.clarification_sentence: This cooperative process is likely important for processing multi-intron pre-mRNAs in human cells.

slots.claim_sentence: Rapid definition of internal exons helps the splicing machinery avoid inappropriate exon skipping.
slots.clarification_sentence: Accurate removal of non-coding regions ensures the production of functional proteins.

slots.claim_sentence: Many membrane proteins fold inefficiently and require the help of enzymes and chaperones.
slots.clarification_sentence: Proteins must fold into specific shapes to work properly within the cell.

slots.claim_sentence: A novel folding assistance system for membrane proteins operates from the cytosolic side of the ER.
slots.clarification_sentence: The endoplasmic reticulum or ER is a compartment where the cell produces proteins.

slots.claim_sentence: Ubiquitination of a specific lysine promotes the folding of the Wnt signaling coreceptor LRP6.
slots.clarification_sentence: This process keeps LRP6 in the ER and prevents the protein from being destroyed.

slots.claim_sentence: For LRP6 to exit the ER, the deubiquitinating enzyme USP19 must remove the ubiquitin.
slots.clarification_sentence: The enzyme USP19 acts as a control switch for the protein to move on.

slots.claim_sentence: The ubiquitination-deubiquitination cycle for LRP6 is similar to the glucosylation-deglucosylation cycle in the ER lumen.
slots.clarification_sentence: Both cycles use the addition and removal of molecules to help proteins fold correctly.

slots.claim_sentence: To prevent futile cycles, folded LRP6 undergoes palmitoylation and ER export.
slots.clarification_sentence: Unsuccessfully folded LRP6 is marked on other lysines and targeted for degradation.

slots.claim_sentence: This ubiquitin-dependent folding system also controls the proteostasis of other membrane proteins like CFTR.
slots.clarification_sentence: These proteins are involved in severe human diseases and often fold poorly.

slots.claim_sentence: Sex-based modulation of cognitive processes may influence individual differences in vulnerability to neuropsychiatric disorders.
slots.clarification_sentence: Many mental health conditions show biases in risk and presentation between sexes.

slots.claim_sentence: Computational tools can uncover latent variables that define different decision-making approaches.
slots.clarification_sentence: These tools find hidden strategies even when animals show similar correct performance.

slots.claim_sentence: The study quantified sex differences in mice using a restless two-armed bandit task.
slots.clarification_sentence: This task is a classic way to measure value-based decision-making behavior.

slots.claim_sentence: Male and female mice had similar accuracy in the decision-making task.
slots.clarification_sentence: However, the mice achieved this performance through different patterns of exploration.

slots.claim_sentence: Male mice tended to make more exploratory choices overall during the task.
slots.clarification_sentence: The males appeared to get stuck in exploration once they had started.

slots.claim_sentence: Female mice tended to explore less but learned more quickly during exploration.
slots.clarification_sentence: Learning more from exploratory trials allowed females to start exploiting rewards earlier.

slots.claim_sentence: Sex exerts stronger influences on decision-making during periods of learning and exploration.
slots.clarification_sentence: These differences are less visible when animals make stable, routine choices.

slots.claim_sentence: Exploration during decision-making is altered in people with addictions and depression.
slots.clarification_sentence: Neural mechanisms of exploration may explain sex-modulated vulnerability to neuropsychiatric diagnoses.

slots.claim_sentence: Researchers must clarify neuronal circuits in the spinal cord dorsal horn to understand pathological pain.
slots.clarification_sentence: The spinal cord dorsal horn is a critical area for processing sensory perception.

slots.claim_sentence: This study used an optogenetic approach to selectively activate spinal interneurons expressing calretinin.
slots.clarification_sentence: Calretinin is a calcium-binding protein found in specific types of nerve cells.

slots.claim_sentence: Calretinin interneurons form an interconnected network that can initiate and sustain excitatory signaling.
slots.clarification_sentence: This network allows the spinal cord to boost and prolong sensory signals.

slots.claim_sentence: These calretinin interneurons directly relay signals to lamina I projection neurons.
slots.clarification_sentence: Projection neurons are responsible for sending sensory information from the spinal cord to the brain.

slots.claim_sentence: Photoactivation of calretinin interneurons in vivo resulted in significant nocifensive behavior.
slots.clarification_sentence: Nocifensive behavior includes actions like paw licking or biting in response to perceived pain.

slots.claim_sentence: The nocifensive behavior caused by activating these neurons was morphine sensitive.
slots.clarification_sentence: Sensitivity to morphine confirms that the observed behaviors are related to pain processing.

slots.claim_sentence: Halorhodopsin-mediated inhibition of calretinin interneurons elevated sensory thresholds.
slots.clarification_sentence: Higher sensory thresholds mean the animals were less sensitive to touch or pain stimuli.

slots.claim_sentence: Dorsal horn circuits involving excitatory calretinin neurons are important for the amplification of pain.
slots.clarification_sentence: These circuits can increase pain signals even without a new injury to the body.

slots.claim_sentence: Calretinin interneurons are identified as a future analgesic target for pain relief.
slots.clarification_sentence: An analgesic target is a specific biological site used to develop new painkilling treatments.

slots.claim_sentence: Mutations in the RAB23 gene cause a condition called Carpenter Syndrome.
slots.clarification_sentence: This syndrome involves developmental problems like extra digits and skull morphogenesis defects.

slots.claim_sentence: Researchers generated Rab23-deficient mice to study how this protein regulates skull development.
slots.clarification_sentence: These mice survived long enough to allow the study of skeletal development.

slots.claim_sentence: The Rab23-deficient mice showed premature fusion of multiple sutures in the skull.
slots.clarification_sentence: This fusion, known as craniosynostosis, results from abnormal growth of bone-forming cells.

slots.claim_sentence: In Rab23-deficient sutures, FGF10-driven FGFR1 signaling is significantly elevated.
slots.clarification_sentence: This change causes an imbalance in MAPK and Hedgehog signaling pathways.

slots.claim_sentence: The imbalance also affects RUNX2 expression, which is vital for bone development.
slots.clarification_sentence: These signaling changes drive the increased bone formation seen in the mice.

slots.claim_sentence: Inhibition of elevated pERK1/2 signaling normalizes the growth of bone-forming cells.
slots.clarification_sentence: This treatment also reduces osteogenic gene expression and prevents skull bone fusion.

slots.claim_sentence: RAB23 acts as an upstream negative regulator of FGFR and Hh-GLI1 signaling.
slots.clarification_sentence: The protein also helps regulate GLI1 through a pathway involving pERK1/2.

slots.claim_sentence: These findings explain how RAB23 coordinates the start of bone formation.
slots.clarification_sentence: The study highlights how multiple pathways interact during early skull development.

slots.claim_sentence: The mice also displayed extra fingers or toes known as polysyndactyly.
slots.clarification_sentence: Abnormal proliferation of bone-forming cells occurs within the skull sutures.

slots.claim_sentence: Cells use the inheritance of gene expression states to remember past events.
slots.clarification_sentence: These events include environmental or developmental cues that the cells have experienced.

slots.claim_sentence: The Polycomb Repressive Complex 2 maintains epigenetic repression of many genes.
slots.clarification_sentence: This complex, known as PRC2, modifies chromatin in both animals and plants.

slots.claim_sentence: It is unclear if inheritance directs long-term memory of individual gene states.
slots.clarification_sentence: This memory could be stored locally in cis or through diffusible factors.

slots.claim_sentence: One copy of the FLC gene can be repressed while another is active.
slots.clarification_sentence: Researchers observed this mixed state within the same Arabidopsis plants.

slots.claim_sentence: This mixed expression state is inherited through many cell divisions.
slots.clarification_sentence: The pattern remains stable as the Arabidopsis plants continue to develop.

slots.claim_sentence: The data demonstrate that epigenetic memory of FLC expression is stored in cis.
slots.clarification_sentence: This finding shows the memory is not stored in trans through diffusible factors.

slots.claim_sentence: The local chromatin environment of FLC instructs its own epigenetic inheritance.
slots.clarification_sentence: Molecular changes to the chromatin are sufficient to maintain the repressed state.

slots.claim_sentence: All four possible combinations of gene activity were observed to be stable.
slots.clarification_sentence: These combinations include states where both gene copies are either on or off.

slots.claim_sentence: DnaK/Hsp70 chaperones form groups called oligomers with a poorly understood structure.
slots.clarification_sentence: These chaperones normally help other proteins fold correctly within the cell.

slots.claim_sentence: Researchers used site-specific proteolysis and crosslinking to study the architecture of BiP oligomers.
slots.clarification_sentence: BiP is a specific chaperone found in the endoplasmic reticulum of the cell.

slots.claim_sentence: BiP oligomers form when an interdomain linker binds to a substrate binding site.
slots.clarification_sentence: This binding between adjacent molecules reduces the chaperone function of the BiP group.

slots.claim_sentence: Native gel electrophoresis showed a reciprocal relationship between unfolded proteins and BiP oligomers.
slots.clarification_sentence: The number of oligomers decreases rapidly when the burden of unfolded proteins increases.

slots.claim_sentence: Lumenal ER calcium depletion caused rapid oligomerization and a diminution in substrate binding.
slots.clarification_sentence: This result confirms the relative inertness of the BiP molecules when in oligomers.

slots.claim_sentence: The balance between inactive oligomers and active monomeric BiP helps buffer protein fluctuations.
slots.clarification_sentence: This equilibration manages the ER unfolded protein load on a very rapid timescale.

slots.claim_sentence: This rapid response is faster than the conventional unfolded protein response in cells.
slots.clarification_sentence: It allows the cell to quickly release active chaperones when they are needed.

slots.claim_sentence: A slower balance exists between oligomers and another inactive form of BiP.
slots.clarification_sentence: This second inactive form of the chaperone is chemically modified.

slots.claim_sentence: The interdomain linker of one molecule acts as a typical substrate for another.
slots.clarification_sentence: This interaction occurs between adjacent protomers within the larger group.

slots.claim_sentence: Flexible filamentous viruses are economically important plant pathogens.
slots.clarification_sentence: These viruses cause serious diseases in many crops and other plants.

slots.claim_sentence: Viral particles contain several hundred copies of a helically arrayed coat protein.
slots.clarification_sentence: This coat protein protects the genetic material known as (+)ssRNA.

slots.claim_sentence: Researchers used electron cryomicroscopy to study the Pepino mosaic virus.
slots.clarification_sentence: The study produced a detailed structure at 3.9 Å resolution.

slots.claim_sentence: The results allow modeling of the coat protein and its interactions.
slots.clarification_sentence: This model shows how the protein binds to the viral RNA.

slots.claim_sentence: The overall fold of the coat protein resembles animal Phlebovirus nucleoproteins.
slots.clarification_sentence: Phleboviruses are a group of viruses that infect animal hosts.

slots.claim_sentence: The main difference between these proteins is in their C-terminal extensions.
slots.clarification_sentence: These extensions determine if the assembly is a flexuous, helical rod.

slots.claim_sentence: The extensions also determine if the assembly is a loose ribonucleoprotein.
slots.clarification_sentence: This structural change alters how the virus particles are shaped.

slots.claim_sentence: The homology suggests gene transfer between eukaryotic (+) and (-) ssRNA viruses.
slots.clarification_sentence: This similarity implies genes moved between different groups of viruses.

slots.claim_sentence: C-terminal extensions are responsible for the axial interactions that support helix formation.
slots.clarification_sentence: The location of the extension in animal viruses prevents longitudinal assembly.

slots.claim_sentence: Systemic vascular pressure in vertebrates is regulated by peripheral resistance in tissue capillary beds.
slots.clarification_sentence: This resistance occurs within the small blood vessels found throughout the body.

slots.claim_sentence: The relationship between hypoxic response in individual tissues and systemic cardiovascular adaptation is unclear.
slots.clarification_sentence: Scientists do not fully understand how specific tissues help the body adapt to oxygen deprivation.

slots.claim_sentence: This study shows how hypoxic response via HIF transcription factors in the skin influences mice.
slots.clarification_sentence: Researchers examined the vascular bed of the skin to track these cardiovascular changes.

slots.claim_sentence: The skin's response to hypoxia influences cardiovascular parameters like heart rate and arterial pressures.
slots.clarification_sentence: Low oxygen levels in the skin also cause changes in overall body temperature.

slots.claim_sentence: This research is the first demonstration of oxygen sensing in a peripheral tissue modifying hypoxia response.
slots.clarification_sentence: The findings show a dynamic role for tissues outside the body's core in cardiovascular control.

slots.claim_sentence: Peripheral tissues and their vascular beds form a complex network of oxygen-responsive tissues.
slots.clarification_sentence: These tissues influence central regulators of cardiovascular function instead of just being influenced.

slots.claim_sentence: Mice lacking specific HIF proteins in the skin show significant changes in blood pressure.
slots.clarification_sentence: These mutant mice also show altered skin temperatures and general activity levels.

slots.claim_sentence: Detecting pathogens and mounting immune responses upon infection is crucial for animal health.
slots.clarification_sentence: These responses help animals survive when they encounter harmful bacteria.

slots.claim_sentence: Immune responses come at a high metabolic price for animals.
slots.clarification_sentence: Avoiding pathogens before infection may be advantageous to save energy.

slots.claim_sentence: Bacterial endotoxins called lipopolysaccharides are important immune system infection cues.
slots.clarification_sentence: It was previously unknown if animals have sensory mechanisms to detect them.

slots.claim_sentence: Drosophila melanogaster fruit flies display strong aversive responses to these bacterial endotoxins.
slots.clarification_sentence: Taste-sensing gustatory neurons with bitter receptors mediate this avoidance during feeding and egg laying.

slots.claim_sentence: The chemosensory cation channel dTRPA1 is necessary for avoiding these bacterial molecules.
slots.clarification_sentence: This protein allows the taste cells to respond to the endotoxins.

slots.claim_sentence: The endotoxins stimulate fly neurons in a manner that depends on dTRPA1.
slots.clarification_sentence: These molecules also activate the same channels when expressed in human cells.

slots.claim_sentence: Flies detect bacterial endotoxins via a taste pathway through TRPA1 activation.
slots.clarification_sentence: This finding suggests a conserved molecular mechanism for sensing harmful bacteria.

slots.claim_sentence: The dTRPA1 channel is a protein that detects chemicals and allows charged particles to pass.
slots.clarification_sentence: This movement of particles through cell membranes leads to a cellular response.

slots.claim_sentence: The generation of naïve T lymphocytes is critical for immune function.
slots.clarification_sentence: The mechanisms governing how these immune cells reach maturation are not fully understood.

slots.claim_sentence: Researchers identified a mouse mutant called bloto with a hypomorphic mutation.
slots.clarification_sentence: This mutation occurs in the zinc finger protein known as Zfp335.

slots.claim_sentence: Zfp335bloto/bloto mice exhibit a naïve T cell deficiency from a developmental defect.
slots.clarification_sentence: This defect affects T cells that have recently undergone thymic egress.

slots.claim_sentence: The effects of Zfp335bloto are multigenic and complex in nature.
slots.clarification_sentence: The defect is not caused by altered thymic selection or Bcl2-dependent survival.

slots.claim_sentence: Zfp335 binds to promoter regions via a specific consensus motif.
slots.clarification_sentence: Its target genes are involved in protein metabolism and mitochondrial function.

slots.claim_sentence: Restoring the expression of one target, Ankle2, partially rescues T cell maturation.
slots.clarification_sentence: This suggests Ankle2 is a key gene regulated by the Zfp335 protein.

slots.claim_sentence: Zfp335 is a transcription factor and essential regulator of T cell maturation.

slots.claim_sentence: The levels of mRNA and protein abundance are often imperfectly correlated in cells.
slots.clarification_sentence: This means the amount of messenger RNA does not always predict protein levels.

slots.claim_sentence: The discrepancy between these levels relates to codon usage and mRNA secondary structure.
slots.clarification_sentence: These two features explain some of the differences in how proteins are made.

slots.claim_sentence: A new factor called mRNA:ncRNA avoidance increases translational efficiency in various organisms.
slots.clarification_sentence: Avoidance refers to how well messenger RNAs stay away from non-coding RNAs.

slots.claim_sentence: Prokaryotes show strong selection for the avoidance of stochastic mRNA:ncRNA interactions.
slots.clarification_sentence: These random interactions have a greater impact on protein abundance than mRNA structure.

slots.claim_sentence: This avoidance effect is also more significant than the impact of codon usage.
slots.clarification_sentence: Researchers estimated the strength of these interactions using a minimum free energy model.

slots.claim_sentence: Scientists tested this by generating synonymously variant green fluorescent protein mRNAs.
slots.clarification_sentence: These GFP variants had different potential for mRNA:ncRNA interactions during the experiment.

slots.claim_sentence: The resulting GFP levels correlate well with the level of interaction avoidance.
slots.clarification_sentence: High avoidance mRNAs produced the highest expression while low avoidance produced the lowest.

slots.claim_sentence: Accounting for stochastic mRNA:ncRNA interactions enables precise modulation of protein abundance.
slots.clarification_sentence: This knowledge allows for better control of protein levels in experimental systems.

slots.claim_sentence: ALS causes the loss of connections between motor neurons and muscles.
slots.clarification_sentence: These connections are called neuromuscular junctions or NMJs.

slots.claim_sentence: Scientists want to know if this loss happens globally or locally.
slots.clarification_sentence: Global loss would mean the entire motor neuron dies at once.

slots.claim_sentence: Researchers used in vivo imaging to track single axons in mice.
slots.clarification_sentence: They observed SOD1G37R mice over a three-month period.

slots.claim_sentence: The study found that single motor-units are dismantled asynchronously.
slots.clarification_sentence: This means the connections do not all fail at the same time.

slots.claim_sentence: Axonal branches are dismantled weeks prior to complete axonal degeneration.
slots.clarification_sentence: During this time, new axonal sprouting also occurs simultaneously.

slots.claim_sentence: This sprouting leads to new synapse formation onto nearby NMJs.
slots.clarification_sentence: The neuron tries to form new connections while losing old ones.

slots.claim_sentence: Denervation events tend to propagate from the first lost NMJ.
slots.clarification_sentence: Distal branches are more susceptible to this spreading loss.

slots.claim_sentence: Neuromuscular factors extrinsic to motor neurons likely drive this pattern.
slots.clarification_sentence: The local environment around the muscle influences how connections fail.

slots.claim_sentence: NMJ denervation in ALS is a complex and dynamic process.
slots.clarification_sentence: It involves continuous denervation and new innervation over time.

slots.claim_sentence: The disease is not a manifestation of sudden global motor neuron degeneration.
slots.clarification_sentence: Instead, the connections break down and rebuild in a slow cycle.

slots.claim_sentence: Adjuvant tamoxifen therapy improves survival in breast cancer patients.
slots.clarification_sentence: This therapy is a standard care for hormone-responsive cancers.

slots.claim_sentence: Long-term treatment causes side effects like hot flashes and fatigue.
slots.clarification_sentence: The drug also causes changes in bone density.

slots.claim_sentence: The specific tissues that mediate these negative side effects are unclear.
slots.clarification_sentence: This uncertainty is partly due to a lack of proven animal models.

slots.claim_sentence: Mice undergoing tamoxifen treatment experience changes in temperature, bone, and movement.
slots.clarification_sentence: Tamoxifen administration in mice increases heat dissipation and decreases movement.

slots.claim_sentence: Tamoxifen treatment induces widespread gene expression changes in the hypothalamus-POA.
slots.clarification_sentence: Researchers used single-cell RNA sequencing to reveal these genetic changes.

slots.claim_sentence: Gene expression changes in the hypothalamus-POA are dependent on estrogen receptor alpha.
slots.clarification_sentence: Removing this receptor in the brain reverses the drug-induced gene changes.

slots.claim_sentence: ERα-deficient mice do not exhibit tamoxifen-induced changes in temperature or bone.
slots.clarification_sentence: Ablating the receptor is sufficient to abrogate effects on core body temperature.

slots.claim_sentence: Estrogen receptor alpha mediates several physiological effects of tamoxifen treatment in mice.
slots.clarification_sentence: The findings provide mechanistic insight into how the drug affects the brain.

slots.claim_sentence: Tamoxifen treatment modulates signaling in the central nervous system to alter health.
slots.clarification_sentence: The receptor plays an indispensable role in the molecular response to treatment.

slots.claim_sentence: Single-molecule Förster Resonance energy transfer is a method used to study biomolecules.
slots.clarification_sentence: This method, known as smFRET, helps researchers observe the structure and dynamics of molecules.

slots.claim_sentence: New commercial instrumentation has outpaced the development of rapid and automated methodologies to analyze data.
slots.clarification_sentence: Existing analysis methods often require manual supervision and expert tuning of specific thresholds.

slots.claim_sentence: DeepFRET is an automated, open-source, standalone solution based on deep learning for analyzing data.
slots.clarification_sentence: The software requires only a user-adjustable quality threshold as the main human intervention.

slots.claim_sentence: DeepFRET outputs common kinetic information metrics by integrating standard features of smFRET analysis.
slots.clarification_sentence: These metrics provide essential measurements about how individual biomolecules move and behave.

slots.claim_sentence: DeepFRET achieved over 95% classification accuracy on ground truth data during testing.
slots.clarification_sentence: The software outperformed human operators while requiring only approximately 1% of the time.

slots.claim_sentence: The precise and rapid operation of DeepFRET allows it to objectively quantify biomolecular dynamics.
slots.clarification_sentence: This tool has the potential to contribute to benchmarking smFRET for dynamic structural biology.

slots.claim_sentence: Capturing real-time readouts of nanometer-scale distances allows direct observations of stochastic non-accumulating events.
slots.clarification_sentence: The technique reveals dynamic equilibria between unsynchronized molecules that are obscured in ensemble techniques.

slots.claim_sentence: Streptococcus pneumoniae is a leading cause of invasive disease in infants in low-income settings.
slots.clarification_sentence: This bacterium can cause serious illnesses such as pneumonia and meningitis.

slots.claim_sentence: Asymptomatic carriage in the nasopharynx is a necessary prerequisite for this disease to occur.
slots.clarification_sentence: The bacteria live in the nose without causing symptoms before they spread.

slots.claim_sentence: Researchers developed a model to calculate the duration of carriage episodes from swab data.
slots.clarification_sentence: The study analyzed data from 598 unvaccinated children over a two year period.

slots.claim_sentence: Pneumococcal genomic variation accounted for 63% of the variation in carriage duration.
slots.clarification_sentence: Host traits like age and previous carriage accounted for less than 5%.

slots.claim_sentence: The study quantified how serotype and drug-resistance affect the duration of carriage.
slots.clarification_sentence: Serotype explained 17% of the variation while drug-resistance explained 9%.

slots.claim_sentence: Specific prophage sequences were linked to decreased carriage duration independent of serotype.
slots.clarification_sentence: This effect may occur through the disruption of the bacterial competence mechanism.

slots.claim_sentence: These findings support theoretical models of pneumococcal competition and antibiotic resistance.
slots.clarification_sentence: The results help explain how different bacterial strains compete within the human host.

slots.claim_sentence: Longer carriage duration increases the likelihood of transmission to another person.
slots.clarification_sentence: Variability in carriage duration was previously only understood at the serotype level.

slots.claim_sentence: Other significant locus effects accounted for 7% of the variation in carriage duration.

slots.claim_sentence: The study investigated how protein mobility depends on protein surface properties and ionic strength.
slots.clarification_sentence: Protein mobility refers to how fast proteins move within the fluid of a cell.

slots.claim_sentence: Researchers used surface-modified fluorescent proteins to determine translational diffusion coefficients in three different organisms.
slots.clarification_sentence: These organisms included Escherichia coli, Lactococcus lactis, and the archaeon Haloferax volcanii.

slots.claim_sentence: In E. coli, the diffusion coefficient depends on the net charge and its distribution.
slots.clarification_sentence: Positive proteins moved up to 100-fold slower than negative ones in this bacterium.

slots.claim_sentence: The effect of protein charge on diffusion is weaker in L. lactis and Hfx. volcanii.
slots.clarification_sentence: This difference occurs because electrostatic screening reduces the electrical interactions in these species.

slots.claim_sentence: The decrease in mobility is likely caused by the interaction of positive proteins with ribosomes.
slots.clarification_sentence: This interaction was shown in vivo and confirmed in vitro with purified ribosomes.

slots.claim_sentence: Ribosome surface properties may thus limit the composition of the cytoplasmic proteome.
slots.clarification_sentence: The cytoplasmic proteome is the entire set of proteins found within the cell fluid.

slots.claim_sentence: Applying these findings to prokaryotic (endo)symbionts reveals a paradox in how these cells function.
slots.clarification_sentence: It remains unclear how these specific organisms avoid slow diffusion and ribosome swarming.

slots.claim_sentence: The biological mechanisms that activate regeneration in animals remain mysterious.
slots.clarification_sentence: Scientists want to understand how bodies know when to start regrowing.

slots.claim_sentence: Planarians show distinct molecular responses to wounds that involve tissue absence.
slots.clarification_sentence: These flatworms can regenerate their entire bodies after a major injury.

slots.claim_sentence: The study identified Smed-follistatin as a gene required for planarian regeneration.
slots.clarification_sentence: This gene is a follistatin homolog found in the flatworm species.

slots.claim_sentence: Smed-follistatin inhibition blocks the specific responses to tissue absence in planarians.
slots.clarification_sentence: However, blocking this gene does not prevent normal tissue turnover.

slots.claim_sentence: Two activin homologs are required for the Smed-follistatin phenotype to occur.
slots.clarification_sentence: These proteins are named Smed-activin-1 and Smed-activin-2.

slots.claim_sentence: Smed-follistatin expression is wound-induced and higher after injuries with tissue absence.
slots.clarification_sentence: The amount of the gene increases when tissue is actually lost.

slots.claim_sentence: Smed-follistatin inhibits Smed-Activin proteins to trigger regeneration after tissue loss.
slots.clarification_sentence: This interaction identifies a critical mechanism for regeneration initiation.

slots.claim_sentence: The requirement for the gene is specific to replacing lost tissue.
slots.clarification_sentence: Normal cell replacement continues even when the gene is not active.

slots.claim_sentence: Planarians mount different reactions depending on whether an injury causes tissue loss.
slots.clarification_sentence: The flatworms distinguish between simple wounds and those requiring major regrowth.

slots.clarification_sentence: These specific tumors are often resistant to standard cancer therapy.

slots.claim_sentence: The mutation signature in these tumors is distinct from other tumor genomes.
slots.clarification_sentence: This signature is surprisingly similar to the DNA found in reproductive cells.

slots.claim_sentence: Uncorrected mutations contribute to a substantial fraction of human genetic variation.
slots.clarification_sentence: These mutations escape the normal mismatch repair process in the body.

slots.claim_sentence: Researchers identified many recurrent indels that help detect microsatellite instability.

slots.claim_sentence: Microsatellite instability is a key characteristic of mismatch repair-deficient tumors.

slots.claim_sentence: Recurrent indels are enriched in the DNA double-strand break repair pathway.
slots.clarification_sentence: This pathway specifically involves repair through a process called homologous recombination.

slots.claim_sentence: DNA double-strand break repair is reduced in mismatch repair-deficient tumors.
slots.clarification_sentence: This reduction makes the tumor cells more vulnerable to certain agents.

slots.claim_sentence: Tumor cultures show a dose-dependent sensitivity to double-strand break inducers.

slots.claim_sentence: Opioid overdose rates in the United States quadrupled between 1999 and 2017.
slots.clarification_sentence: These rising rates led to a staggering 130 deaths per day.

slots.claim_sentence: Finding brain areas and cell types involved in breathing depression is necessary.
slots.clarification_sentence: Opioid-induced respiratory depression causes slow and shallow breathing during an overdose.

slots.claim_sentence: Researchers identified two primary changes to murine breathing after administering opioids.
slots.clarification_sentence: These changes include decreased inspiratory airflow and a new pause phase.

slots.claim_sentence: The researchers confirmed these changes by locally eliminating the µ-Opioid receptor.
slots.clarification_sentence: This receptor is the protein that opioids attach to in the brain.

slots.claim_sentence: The preBötzinger Complex is the critical brain site for opioid sensitivity.
slots.clarification_sentence: This specific brainstem region is where the breathing rhythm originates.

slots.claim_sentence: Just 70–140 neurons in the preBötzinger Complex cause this opioid sensitivity.
slots.clarification_sentence: Genetic tools helped reveal this very small number of responsible cells.

slots.claim_sentence: Characterizing these neurons may lead to therapies that prevent respiratory depression.
slots.clarification_sentence: These new treatments could stop breathing failure while still sparing analgesia.

slots.claim_sentence: These critical neurons are not required for opioid-induced pain relief.
slots.clarification_sentence: This finding suggests a target for developing much safer opioid drugs.

slots.claim_sentence: The pause phase delays the initiation of subsequent breaths in mice.
slots.clarification_sentence: Researchers monitored breathing closely after exposing the animals to opioids.

slots.claim_sentence: Scientists used stereotaxic injection to eliminate receptors from specific cells.
slots.clarification_sentence: This method targeted the brainstem circuitry while sparing other inputs.

slots.clarification_sentence: This process involves DNA sequences moving to new locations in the genome.

slots.claim_sentence: Human cells have evolved strategies to regulate L1 retrotransposition.
slots.clarification_sentence: These strategies help prevent the harmful disruption of vital human genes.

slots.claim_sentence: The APOBEC3 gene family consists of seven enzymes that catalyze deamination.
slots.clarification_sentence: These enzymes change cytidine nucleotides to uridine nucleotides in single-strand DNA.

slots.claim_sentence: APOBEC3A is the most potent inhibitor of L1 retrotransposition in cultured cell assays.
slots.clarification_sentence: This specific enzyme is the strongest member of the family at stopping L1.

slots.claim_sentence: Previous characterization of L1 retrotransposition events did not yield evidence of deamination.
slots.clarification_sentence: Earlier studies failed to detect the expected chemical changes caused by the enzyme.

slots.claim_sentence: The molecular mechanism by which A3A inhibits L1 retrotransposition has remained enigmatic.
slots.clarification_sentence: Scientists did not understand how the protein worked without seeing these changes.

slots.claim_sentence: A3A inhibits L1 retrotransposition by deaminating transiently exposed single-strand DNA.
slots.clarification_sentence: This DNA is briefly exposed during the process of L1 integration.

slots.claim_sentence: These data provide a mechanistic explanation of how the A3A protein inhibits L1.
slots.clarification_sentence: The findings clarify how the enzyme uses its chemical activity to stop mutations.

slots.claim_sentence: Sensory experience shapes neural circuitry by changing how neurons connect and their internal properties.
slots.clarification_sentence: These internal properties determine how easily a single neuron can be activated by signals.

slots.claim_sentence: Researchers studied a protein called Rem2 to understand its role in visual circuit plasticity.
slots.clarification_sentence: Rem2 is an activity-regulated protein that belongs to the Ras-like GTPase family.

slots.claim_sentence: The team generated Rem2 knockout mice to test how this protein influences brain changes.
slots.clarification_sentence: These mice were genetically modified so they no longer produced the Rem2 protein.

slots.claim_sentence: Mice lacking Rem2 fail to show normal ocular dominance plasticity during the critical period.
slots.clarification_sentence: This plasticity is the ability of the brain to adjust to changes in visual input.

slots.claim_sentence: Rem2 regulates the intrinsic excitability of layer 2/3 pyramidal neurons within the brain.
slots.clarification_sentence: This regulation occurs before any changes happen to the connections between these neurons.

slots.claim_sentence: The protein acts within the cell to control how much neurons respond to input.
slots.clarification_sentence: This cell-autonomous role means Rem2 works directly inside the specific neuron it affects.

slots.claim_sentence: Neurons show increased spontaneous firing rates when the Rem2 protein is absent.
slots.clarification_sentence: Higher firing rates mean the neurons are more active even without specific external triggers.

slots.claim_sentence: Both lab dish and living animal recordings confirmed this increase in neural activity.
slots.clarification_sentence: These recordings show that the entire cortical network becomes more active without Rem2.

slots.claim_sentence: Rem2 is a key molecule that regulates neuronal excitability during changing sensory experiences.
slots.clarification_sentence: The protein ensures that visual circuits function correctly as the environment changes.

slots.claim_sentence: This analysis examines how magnetic fields influence biological molecules and cells.
slots.clarification_sentence: The study investigates the fundamental interactions between magnetic fields and biological components.

slots.claim_sentence: The analysis was prompted by recent prominent reports about magnetism in biological systems.
slots.clarification_sentence: These high-profile articles made significant claims about how biology interacts with magnetism.

slots.claim_sentence: One report claims a protein complex guides magnetic orientation in animals like a compass needle.
slots.clarification_sentence: Qin et al., 2016 described this protein complex as a biological compass for orientation.

slots.claim_sentence: Other articles report magnetic control of membrane conductance by attaching ferritin to an ion channel.
slots.clarification_sentence: Stanley et al., 2015 and Wheeler et al., 2016 used magnetic fields to manipulate ferritin.

slots.claim_sentence: The author argues that these claims conflict with basic laws of physics.
slots.clarification_sentence: Calculations show the proposed biophysical schemes are not even remotely plausible.

slots.claim_sentence: The discrepancies between the claims and physics are large, ranging from 5 to 10 log units.
slots.clarification_sentence: These enormous differences span five to ten orders of magnitude.

slots.claim_sentence: If the reported phenomena do occur, their causes must be entirely different from those proposed.
slots.clarification_sentence: The real mechanisms would have to be completely unlike the original suggestions.

slots.claim_sentence: The paramagnetic nature of protein complexes significantly limits their usefulness for engineering magnetically sensitive cells.
slots.clarification_sentence: This inherent property restricts the potential for creating cells controlled by magnetic fields.

slots.claim_sentence: Drosophila neural progenitors, called neuroblasts, are a good model for studying how brain stem cells renew themselves.
slots.clarification_sentence: These neuroblasts can also differentiate into other cell types or enter a dormant state called quiescence.

slots.claim_sentence: The process of quiescence in Drosophila neuroblasts is currently not well understood by scientists.
slots.clarification_sentence: Understanding how these cells switch between states is important for developing new stem cell therapies.

slots.claim_sentence: When neuroblasts enter quiescence, the differentiation factor Prospero is transiently detected in the nucleus.
slots.clarification_sentence: This protein is briefly found at a low level during the transition to the dormant state.

slots.claim_sentence: The entry into quiescence is followed by a unique molecular profile lacking most progenitor markers.
slots.clarification_sentence: This profile also lacks markers that are typically found in cells that have already differentiated.

slots.claim_sentence: The pulse of low level nuclear Prospero precedes neuroblast quiescence even when timing is altered.
slots.clarification_sentence: Researchers tested this by using temporal identity factors to make the dormant state start earlier or later.

slots.claim_sentence: Loss of Prospero prevents neuroblasts from entering quiescence and keeps them in a proliferating state.
slots.clarification_sentence: This shows that the protein is necessary for the brain stem cells to stop dividing.

slots.claim_sentence: A pulse of low level nuclear Prospero can drive proliferating larval neuroblasts into quiescence.
slots.clarification_sentence: This finding confirms that the presence of the protein is sufficient to trigger the dormant state.

slots.claim_sentence: The study proposes that Prospero levels distinguish three progenitor fates for these brain stem cells.
Different levels of Prospero act as a switch to determine the behavior of the neuroblast.

slots.claim_sentence: Peptidylglycine α-amidating monooxygenase is an enzyme required for generating amidated bioactive signaling peptides.

slots.clarification_sentence: Cilia are hair-like structures that project from the surface of many cells.

slots.claim_sentence: Chlamydomonas PAM knockdown lines failed to assemble cilia beyond the transition zone.
slots.clarification_sentence: Chlamydomonas is a type of algae used to study how cells build structures.

slots.claim_sentence: Decreased PAM gene expression reduced motile ciliary density on the ventral surface of planaria.
slots.clarification_sentence: The planaria also showed cytosolic axonemes that lacked a proper ciliary membrane.

slots.claim_sentence: The architecture of primary cilia on neuroepithelial cells in Pam-/- mouse embryos was aberrant.
slots.clarification_sentence: These mutant mouse cells produced cilia that were significantly shorter than normal.

slots.claim_sentence: PAM activity and alterations in post-Golgi trafficking contribute to the observed ciliogenesis defects.
slots.clarification_sentence: The Golgi apparatus is a cell part involved in transporting proteins.

slots.claim_sentence: The study provides an unanticipated, highly conserved link between PAM, amidation, and ciliary assembly.
slots.clarification_sentence: Amidation is a chemical modification that makes signaling peptides active.

slots.claim_sentence: PAM is the only enzyme that carries out this specific peptide modification.

slots.claim_sentence: Class III myosins and the protein Espin help maintain stereocilia in vertebrate hair cells.
slots.clarification_sentence: Defects in these proteins cause hereditary hearing impairments in humans.

slots.claim_sentence: Myo3 interacts with Espin1 through a specific part called the tail homology I motif.
slots.clarification_sentence: Researchers did not know how this interaction regulates actin bundle assembly and stabilization.

slots.claim_sentence: The Myo3 THDI contains repeat sequences that bind strongly to the ankyrin repeats of Espin1.
slots.clarification_sentence: This binding reveals an unexpected mechanism where Myo3 cross-links the Espin1 proteins together.

slots.claim_sentence: The structures of Myo3 in complex with Espin1 explain the exact mechanism of binding.
slots.clarification_sentence: These structures also show how Myo3 releases the auto-inhibition of the Espin1 protein.

slots.claim_sentence: Myo3-mediated cross-linking further promotes the actin fiber bundling activity of Espin1.
slots.clarification_sentence: This process helps stabilize the parallel actin fibers found within the hair cell structures.

slots.claim_sentence: Stereocilia are tiny hair-like structures that are essential for the sense of hearing.
slots.clarification_sentence: The Myo3 and Espin proteins ensure these structures develop and function correctly.

slots.claim_sentence: Each repeat sequence in the Myo3 tail can bind to Espin1 independently.
slots.clarification_sentence: This independent binding allows one Myo3 molecule to hold two Espin1 molecules at once.

slots.claim_sentence: Binding of Myo3-ARBs first releases the inhibited shape of the Espin1 protein.
slots.clarification_sentence: Releasing this shape allows Espin1 to interact more effectively with actin fibers.

slots.claim_sentence: Voltage-gated calcium channels control essential functions in excitable cells like neurons and muscles.
slots.clarification_sentence: These channels are vital for nerve signals and the contraction of heart muscles.

slots.claim_sentence: Different calcium channels activate at different voltages and with distinct kinetics to perform functions.
slots.clarification_sentence: This variety allows different cells to respond to electrical signals at specific speeds.

slots.claim_sentence: Researchers used structure modeling and electrophysiology to study two voltage sensing domains in CaV1.1.
slots.clarification_sentence: The team analyzed how these domains move between activated and resting states.

slots.claim_sentence: Both voltage sensing domains showed typical features but differed in their ion-pair formation.
slots.clarification_sentence: The domains varied in how their outer gating charges interacted with other charges.

slots.claim_sentence: Stabilization of the activated state enhanced the voltage dependence of activation in these domains.
slots.clarification_sentence: In contrast, stabilization of resting states slowed the kinetics of the channel opening.

slots.claim_sentence: This mechanism explains how specific ion-pair formation achieves the gating properties of cation channels.
slots.clarification_sentence: The model shows how separate domains cooperate to establish unique channel behaviors.

slots.claim_sentence: Both domains operated according to the sliding helix model for voltage sensing.
slots.clarification_sentence: The results showed differences in the range of helix movement during activation.

slots.claim_sentence: The study combined mutagenesis with molecular dynamics simulations to identify molecular mechanisms.
slots.clarification_sentence: Markov state modeling helped the team analyze the free energy of the channel.

slots.claim_sentence: Increased interactions in the resting states caused higher energy barriers for the channel.
slots.clarification_sentence: These interactions between gating charges and countercharges determine the slow activation kinetics.

slots.claim_sentence: AMPA receptors are glutamate-gated ion channels found at excitatory synapses in the mammalian brain.
slots.clarification_sentence: These receptors assemble as a dimer-of-dimers to help transmit signals between nerve cells.

slots.claim_sentence: Cryo-electron microscopy structures suggest that AMPA receptor dimers might undergo substantial lateral motions during gating.
slots.clarification_sentence: These lateral motions can cause the extracellular layer of the receptor to open up.

slots.claim_sentence: Researchers used bifunctional methanethiosulfonate cross-linkers to calibrate the conformations of functional AMPA receptors.
slots.clarification_sentence: The study tested these conformations both with and without the auxiliary subunit Stargazin.

slots.claim_sentence: The extracellular layer of AMPA receptors can get trapped in stable, opened-up conformations.
slots.clarification_sentence: This trapping primarily occurs after the receptors experience long exposures to glutamate.

slots.claim_sentence: The auxiliary subunit Stargazin limits the conformational flexibility of these AMPA receptors.
slots.clarification_sentence: Stargazin helps maintain a more compact arrangement of the receptor layers during activity.

slots.claim_sentence: Under synaptic conditions, the extracellular domains of AMPA receptors likely stay compact during gating.
slots.clarification_sentence: These conditions involve brief glutamate exposures and the presence of auxiliary proteins.

slots.claim_sentence: Stargazin reduces the separation between the two dimers within the receptor structure.
slots.clarification_sentence: This restriction ensures the receptor does not move as dramatically as previously thought.

slots.claim_sentence: More opened-up conformations are slower to access than compact ones.
slots.clarification_sentence: Once the receptor reaches these open states, the new shapes remain stable.

slots.claim_sentence: The precise roles that oxidants play in lifespan and aging are still unknown.
slots.clarification_sentence: Scientists are still trying to understand how these chemicals affect how organisms age.

slots.claim_sentence: Chronologically aging yeast cells undergo a sudden redox collapse.
slots.clarification_sentence: This collapse affects over 80% of identified thiol-containing proteins in the cell.

slots.claim_sentence: This redox collapse is not triggered by an increase in endogenous oxidants.
slots.clarification_sentence: This finding goes against what the free radical theory of aging would suggest.

slots.claim_sentence: The collapse appears to be instigated by a substantial drop in cellular NADPH.
slots.clarification_sentence: NADPH normally provides the electron source for maintaining cellular redox homeostasis.

slots.claim_sentence: This decrease in NADPH levels occurs very early during the yeast lifespan.
slots.clarification_sentence: The drop initiates a cascade predicted to down-regulate most cellular processes.

slots.claim_sentence: Caloric restriction increases NADPH levels and delays each facet of the cascade.
slots.clarification_sentence: Caloric restriction is a near-universal lifespan extending measure used in research.

slots.claim_sentence: The study reveals a time line of events leading to proteome oxidation.
slots.clarification_sentence: This system-wide oxidation of the proteome occurs days before cell death.

slots.claim_sentence: Researchers used a quantitative redox proteomic approach to assess these physiological events.
slots.clarification_sentence: The team used chronologically aging yeast as a model system for the study.

slots.claim_sentence: The biological world is homochiral and maintaining this homochirality is essential for cell survival.
slots.clarification_sentence: Homochirality means that cells use only one mirror-image form of molecules like amino acids.

slots.claim_sentence: The enzyme D-aminoacyl-tRNA deacylase selectively removes D-amino acids mistakenly attached to tRNAs.
slots.clarification_sentence: This enzyme is also known as DTD and acts as a proofreading mechanism.

slots.claim_sentence: The crystal structure of dimeric DTD from Plasmodium falciparum shows how the enzyme works.
slots.clarification_sentence: DTD uses a specific Gly-cisPro dipeptide to capture the chiral centre of incoming molecules.

slots.claim_sentence: A side chain-independent mode of substrate recognition allows DTD to act on multiple D-amino acids.
slots.clarification_sentence: This recognition occurs even though no protein residues are directly involved in catalysis.

slots.claim_sentence: Strict chiral specificity explains how the abundant cellular pool of L-aminoacyl-tRNAs escapes this step.
slots.clarification_sentence: The enzyme design ensures that only the incorrect D-form is targeted for removal.

slots.claim_sentence: This study elucidates a chiral enforcement mechanism that prevents D-amino acid infiltration.
slots.clarification_sentence: This fundamental enantioselection process was crucial during the evolution of the translational apparatus.

slots.claim_sentence: The lack of recognition of side chain atoms treats different amino acids alike.
slots.clarification_sentence: This binding pocket is a perfect fit for the shared chiral center.

slots.claim_sentence: The structural design provides an elegant mechanism for rejecting L-chirality from the pocket.
slots.clarification_sentence: L-amino acids are excluded regardless of their specific chemical side chains.

slots.claim_sentence: The CFTR protein is a channel that allows chloride to pass through cells.
slots.clarification_sentence: ATP-binding-induced dimerization of two nucleotide binding domains (NBDs) opens the pore.

slots.claim_sentence: Spontaneous openings without ATP are rare in the wild-type CFTR protein.
slots.clarification_sentence: In certain CF mutants, these spontaneous openings are the only gating mechanism.

slots.claim_sentence: The molecular motions underlying spontaneous gating were previously unclear to researchers.
slots.clarification_sentence: It was unknown if NBDs still form dimers during these spontaneous events.

slots.claim_sentence: This study correlates energetic coupling between residues with spontaneous pore opening.
slots.clarification_sentence: Researchers measured these interactions across the dimer interface in single CFTR channels.

slots.claim_sentence: Spontaneous openings in CFTR are strictly coupled to NBD dimerization.
slots.clarification_sentence: This finding shows that dimerization may occur even without ATP present.

slots.claim_sentence: Coordinated NBD and pore movements are intrinsic to the CFTR protein.
slots.clarification_sentence: ATP alters the stability but not the fundamental structural architecture of conformations.

slots.claim_sentence: The findings provide insights for understanding CF mutation and drug mechanisms.
slots.clarification_sentence: This explains how drugs like ivacaftor affect both ATP-driven and spontaneous activity.

slots.claim_sentence: The results clarify how phosphorylation and mutations influence channel activity.
slots.clarification_sentence: The study offers new insights into how cystic fibrosis treatments work.

slots.claim_sentence: ATP acts as a molecular glue to stabilize the open state.
slots.clarification_sentence: The presence of bound ATP does not alter the global arrangement of conformations.

slots.claim_sentence: Researchers identified a powerful mechanism for the assembly and mobility of transmembrane proteins in lipid bilayers.
slots.clarification_sentence: Transmembrane proteins are essential molecules that must move and group together within cell membranes.

slots.claim_sentence: This force is a pre-transition effect related to the transition between ordered and disordered membrane phases.
slots.clarification_sentence: The membrane can shift between a neatly aligned ordered state and a more irregular disordered state.

slots.claim_sentence: Large-scale molecular simulation showed that a protein can stabilize a microscopic order-disorder interface.
slots.clarification_sentence: This occurs when the protein hydrophobic thickness matches the disordered phase within an ordered bilayer.

slots.claim_sentence: When two proteins approach each other, they assemble to reduce the net interfacial energy.
slots.clarification_sentence: The tension of the interface pulls the two proteins together into a single group.

slots.claim_sentence: The researchers named this phenomenon the orderphobic effect, which is analogous to the hydrophobic effect.
slots.clarification_sentence: The orderphobic effect leverages the power of a phase transition to drive protein interactions.

slots.claim_sentence: The orderphobic effect is influenced by the proximity to the order-disorder phase transition.
slots.clarification_sentence: The protein size and hydrophobic mismatch also determine the strength of this specific effect.

slots.claim_sentence: The strength and range of the orderphobic effect are significantly larger than membrane elasticity forces.
slots.clarification_sentence: This suggests the effect is a dominant force for protein assembly in the membranes studied.

slots.claim_sentence: The Brazilian cave insect Neotrogla has a functional switching valve within its female genitalia.
slots.clarification_sentence: Neotrogla is a minute insect that lives in dark cave environments in Brazil.

slots.claim_sentence: Female Neotrogla possess a penis-like intromittent organ to coercively anchor males and obtain voluminous semen.
slots.clarification_sentence: This female penis allows the insect to stay attached to the male for long periods.

slots.claim_sentence: The semen capsule in Neotrogla is used for fertilization and consumed by the female as nutrition.
slots.clarification_sentence: The female digests the contents of the capsule to gain energy in her habitat.

slots.claim_sentence: The valve complex in Neotrogla has two slots for insemination, allowing continued mating while one slot is occupied.

slots.claim_sentence: SNARE proteins help release neurotransmitters through a step-by-step assembly process.
slots.clarification_sentence: This release of chemical messengers depends on a protein called Munc18-1.

slots.claim_sentence: The specific roles of these assembly stages are not well understood.
slots.clarification_sentence: How Munc18-1 controls this protein assembly also remains unclear.

slots.claim_sentence: Researchers used optical tweezers to observe four distinct stages of SNARE assembly.
slots.clarification_sentence: These stages involve the N-terminal, middle, C-terminal, and linker domains.

slots.claim_sentence: Specific mutations in SNARE layers differentially affect how the proteins assemble.
slots.clarification_sentence: Some changes cause minor effects while others significantly alter the assembly speed.

slots.claim_sentence: The N-terminal domain is responsible for docking vesicles to the membrane.
slots.clarification_sentence: The C-terminal domain drives the final fusion of the membranes together.

slots.claim_sentence: The middle domain regulates both the assembly process and membrane fusion.
slots.clarification_sentence: Each part of the protein performs a unique task during neurotransmitter release.

slots.claim_sentence: Munc18-1 initiates SNARE assembly and stabilizes a half-zippered protein complex.
slots.clarification_sentence: This stabilization requires a specific region called the N-terminal regulatory domain.

slots.claim_sentence: SNARE domains have distinct functions that are closely chaperoned by Munc18-1.
slots.clarification_sentence: Munc18-1 acts on folding intermediates to guide the entire assembly process.

slots.claim_sentence: The C-terminal domain acts as a power stroke to drive membrane fusion.
slots.clarification_sentence: The middle domain is essential for regulating the kinetics of this fusion.

slots.claim_sentence: A major question is how the integrin adhesome forms complex cell-matrix adhesion sites rapidly and correctly.
slots.clarification_sentence: These sites are structures that cells use to attach to their surrounding environment.

slots.claim_sentence: Adhesion sites change their molecular content by exchanging components with the surrounding cytosol.
slots.clarification_sentence: The cytosol is the internal fluid that fills the inside of a cell.

slots.claim_sentence: The integrin adhesome is extensively pre-assembled in the cytosol as multi-protein building blocks.
slots.clarification_sentence: Researchers used fluorescence cross-correlation spectroscopy and fluorescence recovery after photobleaching to find these blocks.

slots.claim_sentence: Stationary focal adhesions release the same types of protein complexes that they recruit.
slots.clarification_sentence: This symmetric exchange keeps the cytosolic pool of building blocks spatiotemporally uniform.

slots.claim_sentence: Multi-protein building blocks enable rapid and modular self-assembly of adhesion sites.
slots.clarification_sentence: Using pre-assembled blocks reduces the number of steps required for the assembly process.

slots.claim_sentence: Symmetric exchange of multi-protein building blocks preserves their specifications and the assembly logic.
slots.clarification_sentence: This process ensures that building blocks enter and exit adhesion sites without being altered.

slots.claim_sentence: A standardized pool of building blocks is essential for correct and efficient assembly.
slots.clarification_sentence: Symmetric material exchange retains the wiring and switchability of the system.

slots.claim_sentence: Symmetric exchange prevents communication between different adhesion sites via primed components.
slots.clarification_sentence: The mechanism ensures that building blocks can be re-used repeatedly and accurately.

slots.claim_sentence: Interpreting visual scenes typically requires people to accumulate information from multiple locations in a scene.
slots.clarification_sentence: Many situations require multiple fixations to extract several details at different locations to make a decision.

slots.claim_sentence: Participants in a visual categorization task followed an active sensing strategy to choose their eye movements.
slots.clarification_sentence: This strategy incorporates information already acquired about the scene and knowledge of the statistical structure of patterns.

slots.claim_sentence: The study used a novel gaze-contingent paradigm to track how people successively revealed small image apertures.
slots.clarification_sentence: This method allowed researchers to assess how participants actively chose where to look during the task.

slots.claim_sentence: Categorization performance markedly improved when an optimal Bayesian active sensor algorithm revealed the locations to participants.
slots.clarification_sentence: The algorithm chose the next fixation location to maximally reduce uncertainty about the image category.

slots.claim_sentence: A major portion of human suboptimality arises from prior biases, perceptual noise, and inaccuracies in eye movements.
slots.clarification_sentence: The central process of selecting fixation locations was found to be around 70% efficient in this task.

slots.claim_sentence: Participants select eye movements with the goal of maximizing information about abstract categories.
slots.clarification_sentence: This process requires the integration of information from multiple locations to solve the task efficiently.

slots.claim_sentence: The task required a closed-loop interaction between perception and the planning of each new eye movement.
slots.clarification_sentence: No single location was enough to solve the task without combining data from several different spots.
