slots.claim_sentence: The nuclear pore complex regulates the movement of molecules into the nucleus.
slots.clarification_sentence: This complex acts as a gatekeeper for transport between cell compartments.

slots.claim_sentence: Scientists lack a quantitative understanding of how large cargoes enter the nucleus.
slots.clarification_sentence: The roles of cargo size and binding sequences remain poorly understood.

slots.claim_sentence: Researchers tested thirty large cargo models based on four capsid-like particles.
slots.clarification_sentence: These particles ranged from 17 to 36 nanometers in size.

slots.claim_sentence: The study used particles with up to 240 nuclear localisation sequences.
slots.clarification_sentence: These sequences allow the particles to bind to transport receptors.

slots.claim_sentence: A simple biophysical model explains the requirements for this nuclear transport.
slots.clarification_sentence: The model uses two parameters to correlate import flux with energetics.

slots.claim_sentence: The model links the energy of transport to the rate of movement.
slots.clarification_sentence: This physical model explains the experimental data for each capsid type.

slots.claim_sentence: The results reveal key molecular determinants of large cargo import in cells.
slots.clarification_sentence: These findings identify factors that govern how large molecules enter the nucleus.

slots.claim_sentence: The strategy allowed the team to titrate the number of binding sites.
slots.clarification_sentence: The researchers also adjusted the surface properties of the model cargoes.

slots.claim_sentence: The biophysical model explains the experimental data with only two fitting parameters.
slots.clarification_sentence: The model rationalizes the results using a minimal physical framework.

slots.claim_sentence: Cdc48 has a new function in the ubiquitin-dependent regulation of mitochondrial dynamics.
slots.clarification_sentence: Mitochondrial dynamics include the process of fusion where mitochondria combine.

slots.claim_sentence: The deubiquitylases Ubp12 and Ubp2 have opposing effects on mitochondrial fusion.
slots.clarification_sentence: These enzymes cleave different ubiquitin chains on the mitofusin protein Fzo1.

slots.claim_sentence: Cdc48 integrates the activities of Ubp12 and Ubp2 which are themselves ubiquitylated.
slots.clarification_sentence: This means Cdc48 acts as a central regulator for these two enzymes.

slots.claim_sentence: Cdc48 promotes the proteolysis of Ubp12 to stabilize pro-fusion ubiquitylation on Fzo1.
slots.clarification_sentence: Proteolysis is the breakdown of proteins within the cell.

slots.claim_sentence: Loss of Ubp12 stabilizes Ubp2 to facilitate removal of ubiquitin chains inhibiting fusion.
slots.clarification_sentence: This removal of specific chains on Fzo1 allows mitochondrial fusion to occur.

slots.claim_sentence: Cdc48 synergistically regulates the ubiquitylation status of Fzo1 to control fusion balance.
slots.clarification_sentence: This control determines the activation or repression of mitochondrial fusion events.

slots.claim_sentence: The study unravels a new cascade of ubiquitylation events involving Cdc48 and two DUBs.
slots.clarification_sentence: This cascade fine-tunes the fusogenic activity of the Fzo1 protein.

slots.claim_sentence: Cdc48 is required to maintain the Fzo1 protein to promote fusion events.
slots.clarification_sentence: The protein Fzo1 is a key gatekeeper of the fusion mechanism.

slots.claim_sentence: Cdc48 supports the degradation of Ubp12 in a proteasome-dependent manner.
slots.clarification_sentence: The proteasome is a cellular structure that breaks down unwanted proteins.

slots.clarification_sentence: The molecular ways these microbes change host behavior are poorly understood.

slots.clarification_sentence: The team established methods to infect lab fruit flies with this fungus.

slots.claim_sentence: Lab-infected flies exhibit specific moribund behaviors before they die.
slots.clarification_sentence: The flies climb upward and raise their wings to release fungal spores.

slots.claim_sentence: Infected flies extend their proboscides to affix themselves in place.
slots.clarification_sentence: This final pose allows spores to launch from the fly abdomens.

slots.claim_sentence: The fungus E. muscae invades the nervous system of the fly.

slots.claim_sentence: The D. melanogaster system offers a vast molecular toolkit for study.

slots.claim_sentence: Researchers can now explore how E. muscae manipulates its host.

slots.claim_sentence: The fungus is present in the nervous system early in infection.

slots.claim_sentence: Cilia and flagella are assembled and maintained by a process called intraflagellar transport.
slots.clarification_sentence: This mechanism, known as IFT, involves more than 20 different proteins.

slots.claim_sentence: The specific functions of individual IFT proteins are currently mostly unclear.
slots.clarification_sentence: Researchers need to understand how each protein contributes to the transport system.

slots.claim_sentence: This study focused on a specific protein called TTC26/DYF13.
slots.clarification_sentence: Scientists suspected that TTC26/DYF13 was a part of the IFT machinery.

slots.claim_sentence: TTC26/DYF13 is an IFT complex B protein in mammalian cells and algae.
slots.clarification_sentence: The researchers used live imaging and biochemical approaches to confirm this finding.

slots.claim_sentence: Reducing this protein in zebrafish embryos resulted in short cilia with abnormal motility.
slots.clarification_sentence: Mutations in the algae C. reinhardtii also caused similar defects in movement.

slots.claim_sentence: IFT particle assembly and speed were normal in the dyf13 mutant flagella.
slots.clarification_sentence: This result is different from what is seen in other complex B mutants.

slots.claim_sentence: A specific set of motility-related proteins was depleted in the dyf13 mutant.
slots.clarification_sentence: Proteomic and biochemical analyses were used to identify these missing proteins.

slots.claim_sentence: These results show that different IFT proteins are responsible for different cargo subsets.
slots.clarification_sentence: This finding helps explain the overall complexity of the IFT machinery.

slots.claim_sentence: Lymphatic invasion and lymph node metastasis correlate with poor clinical outcome in melanoma.
slots.clarification_sentence: Melanoma is an aggressive skin cancer that often spreads through the lymphatic system.

slots.claim_sentence: The mechanisms of lymphatic dissemination in distant metastasis remain incompletely understood.
slots.clarification_sentence: Researchers want to know how cancer cells move from lymph vessels to distant organs.

slots.claim_sentence: Exposure of human WM852 melanoma cells to lymphatic endothelial cells promotes distant organ metastasis.
slots.clarification_sentence: This interaction was studied using a 3D co-culture method and tested in mice.

slots.claim_sentence: The metastatic melanoma cells adopted an invasively sprouting phenotype in a 3D matrix.
slots.clarification_sentence: This change in cell behavior depended on the proteins MMP14, Notch3, and β1-integrin.

slots.claim_sentence: MMP14 was necessary for LEC-induced Notch3 induction and coincident β1-integrin activation.
slots.clarification_sentence: The protein MMP14 acts as a key upstream regulator to trigger these other proteins.

slots.claim_sentence: MMP14 and Notch3 were required for LEC-mediated metastasis of zebrafish xenografts.
slots.clarification_sentence: Zebrafish models confirmed that these proteins are essential for the cancer to spread.

slots.claim_sentence: This study uncovers a unique mechanism whereby LEC contact promotes melanoma metastasis.
slots.clarification_sentence: The contact induces a reversible switch from 3D growth to an invasively sprouting phenotype.

slots.claim_sentence: MicroRNAs are small noncoding RNAs that regulate gene expression after transcription.
slots.clarification_sentence: One specific type called miR-9 is very abundant in the brain.

slots.claim_sentence: The role of miR-9 in dendritic and synaptic development was previously unknown.
slots.clarification_sentence: Dendrites are tree-like structures on neurons that receive signals from other cells.

slots.claim_sentence: Researchers developed a transgenic miRNA sponge mouse line to study miR-9.
slots.clarification_sentence: This model allows for the conditional inactivation of the miR-9 family.

slots.claim_sentence: The sponge mouse line enables inactivation in a spatio-temporal-controlled manner.
slots.clarification_sentence: This method allows scientists to turn off miR-9 at specific times.

slots.claim_sentence: The study found that miR-9 controls dendritic growth in living organisms.
slots.clarification_sentence: The miR-9 family also regulates synaptic transmission between neurons.

slots.claim_sentence: The downregulation of the transcriptional repressor REST is essential for growth.
slots.clarification_sentence: This miR-9-mediated process ensures that dendrites develop properly in the brain.

slots.claim_sentence: Increased REST levels are the major mediator of miR-9 effects.
slots.clarification_sentence: Reducing REST activity allows genes for dendritic maturation to function.

slots.claim_sentence: The protein REST normally stops certain genes from being expressed.
slots.clarification_sentence: The miR-9 molecule binds to RNA to interfere with REST production.

slots.claim_sentence: Mice lacking miR-9 activity exhibit specific defects in dendritic growth.
slots.clarification_sentence: These transgenic mice also show impaired transmission at the synapses.

slots.claim_sentence: Social visual engagement difficulties are early signs of autism spectrum disorder (ASD).
slots.clarification_sentence: Researchers can measure these early signs using eye tracking methods.

slots.claim_sentence: It is unclear how these difficulties link to atypical early brain organization.
slots.clarification_sentence: The study examined how brain circuit connectivity is affected in early development.

slots.claim_sentence: ASD toddlers show functional hypoconnectivity between social brain circuitry and visual networks.
slots.clarification_sentence: The researchers used resting state fMRI in a large sample of toddlers.

slots.claim_sentence: One eye tracking-identified ASD subtype is called GeoPref ASD.
slots.clarification_sentence: GeoPref ASD shows marked hypoconnectivity between the default mode network and visual cortex.

slots.claim_sentence: Increased DMN-OTC hypoconnectivity relates to more severe social-communication difficulties.
slots.clarification_sentence: This specific relationship is only observed in the GeoPref ASD subtype.

slots.claim_sentence: Early social-visual circuit hypoconnectivity is a key neurobiological feature of GeoPref ASD.
slots.clarification_sentence: This feature may be critical for future social-communicative development.

slots.claim_sentence: These brain connectivity patterns could represent new treatment targets for early intervention.
slots.clarification_sentence: Understanding these patterns helps explain why individuals vary in response to treatment.

slots.claim_sentence: The default mode network appears functionally disconnected from the dorsal attention network.
slots.clarification_sentence: This disconnection occurs within the first four years of life.

slots.claim_sentence: GeoPref ASD toddlers prefer looking at geometric shapes over social stimuli.
slots.clarification_sentence: A novel eye tracking paradigm objectively quantifies this specific deficit.

slots.claim_sentence: In Drosophila melanogaster, the lymph gland produces plasmatocytes and crystal cells.
slots.clarification_sentence: These blood cells are not released until the pupariation stage.

slots.claim_sentence: Both plasmatocyte and crystal cell numbers increase throughout larval development.
slots.clarification_sentence: This increase happens even though the lymph gland remains closed.

slots.claim_sentence: Mature plasmatocytes can proliferate to create more blood cells.
slots.clarification_sentence: It was unknown if crystal cell numbers increase by self-renewal.

slots.claim_sentence: New crystal cells in third instar larvae originate through plasmatocyte transdifferentiation.
slots.clarification_sentence: This conversion process depends on the Notch signaling pathway.

slots.claim_sentence: The transdifferentiation process occurs specifically within sessile hemocyte clusters.
slots.clarification_sentence: The process depends on the structural integrity of these clusters.

slots.claim_sentence: The sessile hemocyte clusters function as a true hematopoietic tissue.
slots.clarification_sentence: This tissue uses structure-dependent signaling to promote blood homeostasis.

slots.claim_sentence: This discovery helps researchers compare Drosophila hematopoiesis to vertebrate systems.
slots.clarification_sentence: The finding creates a new paradigm for studying blood development.

slots.claim_sentence: The lymph gland is a specialized organ for blood cell production.
slots.clarification_sentence: Differentiated cells in this organ do not contribute to circulating populations.

slots.claim_sentence: No mature crystal cell has been seen dividing during larval stages.
slots.clarification_sentence: The lack of division creates a paradox regarding cell expansion.

slots.claim_sentence: Mature phagocytic plasmatocytes turn into non-phagocytic crystal cells.
slots.clarification_sentence: Notch signaling is necessary to form these new cells.

slots.claim_sentence: Aneuploidy is linked to many diseases but also helps organisms evolve.
slots.clarification_sentence: Aneuploidy occurs when cells have an abnormal number of chromosomes.

slots.claim_sentence: It is unclear how cells overcome the harmful effects of aneuploidy before new traits evolve.
slots.clarification_sentence: Extra chromosomes often cause toxic effects that cells must manage.

slots.claim_sentence: Aneuploidy is common in wild yeast isolates which show lower-than-expected expression at many amplified genes.
slots.clarification_sentence: Laboratory strains are sensitive to aneuploidy and do not tolerate extra chromosomes well.

slots.claim_sentence: Gene-dosage compensation functions at 10–30% of amplified genes in diploid yeast strains.
slots.clarification_sentence: Researchers tested this by creating diploid strain panels with two, three, or four chromosome copies.

slots.claim_sentence: Genes subject to dosage compensation show elevated rates of gene amplification in wild populations.
slots.clarification_sentence: This indicates that copy-number variation is buffered at these specific genes.

slots.claim_sentence: Aneuploidy provides an ecological advantage to oak strain YPS1009 by amplifying a causal gene.
slots.clarification_sentence: This specific gene escapes dosage compensation to allow for higher expression.

slots.claim_sentence: Dosage compensation buffers gene amplification through aneuploidy to provide a route to rapid phenotypic evolution.
slots.clarification_sentence: This natural process is likely transient rather than a permanent state.

slots.claim_sentence: Genes subject to dosage compensation are under higher expression constraint in wild populations.
slots.clarification_sentence: Active dosage compensation constrains expression despite underlying gene amplification.

slots.claim_sentence: Xenopsin is a recently classified subtype of opsin that challenges current views on photoreceptor evolution.
slots.clarification_sentence: Opsins are light-sensitive proteins that allow animals to detect light in their environment.

slots.claim_sentence: Xenopsins were initially grouped with ciliary opsins but diverged before bilaterian animals existed.
slots.clarification_sentence: This divergence occurred in pre-bilaterian times before most modern animal groups appeared.

slots.claim_sentence: Researchers studied xenopsin in the flatworm Maritigrella crozieri to locate its expression.
slots.clarification_sentence: The protein appears in larval eyes and in extraocular cells near the adult brain.

slots.claim_sentence: The extraocular cells in Maritigrella crozieri contain hundreds of cilia within a phaosome.
slots.clarification_sentence: A phaosome is a specialized intra-cellular vacuole that houses these many hair-like cilia.

slots.claim_sentence: Functional assays in human cells show Maritigrella xenopsin drives light detection using Gαi.
slots.clarification_sentence: This process of phototransduction allows the cell to convert light into a chemical signal.

slots.claim_sentence: The findings show similarities between xenopsin and c-opsin in their cellular structure.
slots.clarification_sentence: This novel cell type encloses its ciliary membrane within its own plasma membrane.

slots.claim_sentence: This unique structure is similar to the rods found in the eyes of jawed vertebrates.
slots.clarification_sentence: Vertebrate rods are specialized cells that help animals see in low light conditions.

slots.claim_sentence: Brain cells use spatial and temporal cues to create diverse types of neurons.
slots.clarification_sentence: Scientists do not yet understand how neural progenitors integrate these different signals.

slots.claim_sentence: Drosophila neuroblasts are a useful model for studying how these cells develop.
slots.clarification_sentence: Researchers can identify individual neuroblasts and track their specific transcription factors.

slots.claim_sentence: The study investigated if spatial and temporal factors act independently or sequentially.
slots.clarification_sentence: This helps explain how early brain cells choose their final identity.

slots.claim_sentence: Researchers used Targeted DamID to map Hunchback binding in two specific neuroblasts.
slots.clarification_sentence: The two cells, NB5-6 and NB7-4, produce different types of progeny.

slots.claim_sentence: Hunchback targets were different in each neuroblast, ruling out the independent model.
slots.clarification_sentence: The independent model predicts that the factor would bind to identical sites.

slots.claim_sentence: Each neuroblast had distinct open chromatin domains that correlated with Hunchback binding.
slots.clarification_sentence: Open chromatin refers to regions where DNA is accessible to transcription factors.

slots.claim_sentence: The spatial factor Gsb/Pax3 correlated with open chromatin in NB5-6 only.
slots.clarification_sentence: This factor is expressed in NB5-6 but is absent in the other cell.

slots.claim_sentence: Spatial factors like Gsb establish specific open chromatin domains in each lineage.
slots.clarification_sentence: This allows temporal factors to bind and produce different neurons in each lineage.

slots.claim_sentence: P2X receptors are ion channels that open a transmembrane pore when they detect extracellular ATP.
slots.clarification_sentence: This opening allows ions to flow through the membrane and initiate signals inside the cell.

slots.claim_sentence: The exact mechanism of pore opening in P2X receptors is still considered controversial.
slots.clarification_sentence: More data is needed to understand how these receptors move in a natural membrane environment.

slots.claim_sentence: Researchers used photo-switchable cross-linkers as molecular tweezers to monitor distances in the P2X2 receptor.
slots.clarification_sentence: These tools allow light to control the distance between specific parts of the receptor domain.

slots.claim_sentence: The study combined experimental structural constraints with computational studies to create high-resolution models.
slots.clarification_sentence: These models show the P2X2 channel in both its open and closed states.

slots.claim_sentence: The study found that outer pore expansion is significantly reduced compared to previous structures.
slots.clarification_sentence: This indicates that the open state of the P2X2 receptor is more compact than expected.

slots.claim_sentence: Data reveal that adjacent pore-lining helices come closer during opening through a hinge-bending motion.
slots.clarification_sentence: This vertical bending at a critical hinge is essential for the activation of the receptor.

slots.claim_sentence: The results provide new insight into the gating mechanism of P2X receptors.
slots.clarification_sentence: This versatile strategy can also be applied to study other membrane proteins.

slots.claim_sentence: Genome instability is linked to errors during cell division and cancer.
slots.clarification_sentence: These mitotic errors occur when cells fail to divide their DNA correctly.

slots.claim_sentence: Genome instability can lead to harmful genetic rearrangements but also to genetic novelty.
slots.clarification_sentence: Genetic novelty refers to new genetic variations that can be passed to offspring.

slots.claim_sentence: Researchers studied extreme chromosomal restructuring during genome elimination in Arabidopsis plants.
slots.clarification_sentence: This process occurs when plants with different centromere histones H3 are hybridized.

slots.claim_sentence: Shattered chromosomes are formed specifically from the genome of the haploid inducer.
slots.clarification_sentence: The haploid inducer is the parent plant that triggers the loss of chromosomes.

slots.claim_sentence: Analysis suggests that DNA breaks are repaired through non-homologous end joining.
slots.clarification_sentence: Non-homologous end joining is a pathway that reconnects broken DNA strands.

slots.claim_sentence: Mutating DNA Ligase 4, a required NHEJ factor, increases haploid recovery.
slots.clarification_sentence: DNA Ligase 4 is a protein that helps the cell repair DNA breaks.

slots.claim_sentence: The heritability and stability of a rearranged chromosome suggest lasting genomic novelty.
slots.clarification_sentence: Heritability means these complex changes can be inherited by the next generation.

slots.claim_sentence: Arabidopsis provides a natural system to investigate rearrangements similar to human disorders.
slots.clarification_sentence: This plant model helps scientists study complex DNA changes found in human diseases.

slots.claim_sentence: Heterostyly is a widespread floral adaptation that promotes outbreeding in plants.
slots.clarification_sentence: This adaptation involves flowers having different arrangements of their reproductive organs.

slots.claim_sentence: In Primula primroses, heterostyly is controlled by the S-locus supergene.
slots.clarification_sentence: The S-locus supergene determines the reciprocal arrangement of reproductive organs.

slots.claim_sentence: The study identified the Primula CYP734A50 gene as the G locus.
slots.clarification_sentence: The CYP734A50 gene determines the style-length dimorphism in these flowers.

slots.claim_sentence: The CYP734A50 gene encodes a putative brassinosteroid-degrading enzyme.
slots.clarification_sentence: Brassinosteroids are plant hormones that typically promote growth in tissues.

slots.claim_sentence: The CYP734A50 gene is only present on the short-styled S-morph haplotype.
slots.clarification_sentence: This gene is specifically expressed in the styles of S-morph flowers.

slots.claim_sentence: The loss or inactivation of CYP734A50 leads to long styles.
slots.clarification_sentence: This confirms the gene is necessary for maintaining short style lengths.

slots.claim_sentence: The CYP734A50 gene arose by a duplication specific to the Primulaceae lineage.
slots.clarification_sentence: The gene also shows an accelerated rate of molecular evolution.

slots.claim_sentence: The results provide a mechanistic explanation for the Primula style-length dimorphism.
slots.clarification_sentence: These findings shed light on the evolution of the S-locus supergene.

slots.claim_sentence: The S-locus supergene also controls incompatibility between the two flower types.
slots.clarification_sentence: This genetic system prevents self-pollination between different flower morphs.

slots.claim_sentence: The S-locus serves as a model for a complex plant supergene.
slots.clarification_sentence: The study clarifies how complex genetic clusters evolve in plants.

slots.claim_sentence: Cep120 maintains centrosome balance by inhibiting the untimely maturation of daughter centrioles.

slots.claim_sentence: The findings define a new molecular defect underlying several genetic ciliopathy diseases.

slots.claim_sentence: Cep120 depletion disrupts the movement of proteins along the microtubule network.

slots.claim_sentence: Establishing the time since death is critical in every death investigation.
slots.clarification_sentence: This time period is known as the postmortem interval or PMI.

slots.claim_sentence: Forensic entomology is a common method used to assess the postmortem interval.
slots.clarification_sentence: However, errors in this insect-based method can range from days to months.

slots.claim_sentence: Microbes may provide a novel method for estimating PMI to avoid limitations.
slots.clarification_sentence: These tiny organisms are ubiquitous and can be quantified using DNA sequencing.

slots.claim_sentence: Postmortem microbial community changes are dramatic and repeatable in a mouse model system.
slots.clarification_sentence: These measurable changes allowed PMI estimation within approximately 3 days over 48 days.

slots.claim_sentence: The results provide a detailed understanding of bacterial and microbial eukaryotic ecology.
slots.clarification_sentence: Microbial community data could be developed into a forensic tool for estimating PMI.

slots.claim_sentence: Researchers sampled both the surface and interior of each corpse during decomposition.
slots.clarification_sentence: The study used a highly replicated experiment to track these temporal changes.

slots.claim_sentence: Consistent shifts in specific bacterial and eukaryotic taxa occurred during decomposition stages.
slots.clarification_sentence: These predictable shifts in microbial presence help track the progression of decay.

slots.claim_sentence: Accurate PMI estimates facilitate the identification of victims and suspects in investigations.
slots.clarification_sentence: Current techniques are often susceptible to various errors and biases.

slots.claim_sentence: Previous studies observed a large mobile extrasynaptic AMPAR pool at synapses.
slots.clarification_sentence: This suggested that AMPA receptors wait outside the synapse for available space.

slots.claim_sentence: Researchers used super-resolution microscopy to examine AMPAR trafficking in post-synaptic densities from rats.
slots.clarification_sentence: The study investigated AMPAR movement both outside and inside the post-synaptic densities.

slots.claim_sentence: Organic fluorescent dyes and different-sized quantum dots were coupled to the AMPARs.
slots.clarification_sentence: The probes included 4 nm dyes, 10 nm sQDs, and 20 nm bQDs.

slots.claim_sentence: More than 90% of AMPARs labeled with dyes or sQDs diffused in confined nanodomains.
slots.clarification_sentence: These nanodomains within the post-synaptic densities remained stable for 15 minutes or longer.

slots.claim_sentence: Less than 10% of sQD-AMPARs were extrasynaptic and highly mobile.
slots.clarification_sentence: This finding contradicts the assumption that most receptors stay outside the synapse.

slots.claim_sentence: In contrast, 90–95% of AMPARs labeled with big quantum dots were extrasynaptic.
slots.clarification_sentence: Big quantum dots are likely blocked from entering the narrow synaptic clefts.

slots.claim_sentence: The findings suggest that AMPARs rapidly enter stable nanodomains in post-synaptic densities.
slots.clarification_sentence: The receptors do not accumulate in extrasynaptic membranes as previously thought.

slots.claim_sentence: AMPA receptor entry is not limited by a small number of available slots.
slots.clarification_sentence: The stable nanodomains may regulate access to chemical signals from other neurons.

slots.claim_sentence: Low oxygen levels in central neurons cause an increase in voltage-gated sodium current.
slots.clarification_sentence: This specific sodium current is known as INa.

slots.claim_sentence: Hypoxia activates the Small Ubiquitin-like Modifier pathway in rat cerebellar granule neurons.
slots.clarification_sentence: This pathway is also called the SUMO pathway.

slots.claim_sentence: The SUMOylation of NaV1.2 channels increases the voltage-gated sodium current.
slots.clarification_sentence: NaV1.2 channels are proteins that allow sodium to enter cells.

slots.claim_sentence: Mutation of NaV1.2-Lys38 prevents both SUMOylation and the increase in INa.
slots.clarification_sentence: A deSUMOylating enzyme also prevents these changes from occurring.

slots.claim_sentence: Hypoxia-induced linkage of SUMO1 to the channels is complete within 40 seconds.
slots.clarification_sentence: This rapid linkage shifts the voltage-dependence of channel activation.

slots.claim_sentence: The shift in activation allows depolarizing steps to evoke larger sodium currents.
slots.clarification_sentence: Larger currents mean more sodium ions flow into the neurons.

slots.claim_sentence: The SUMO pathway and NaV1.2 are potential targets for neuroprotective interventions.
slots.clarification_sentence: These targets are important because INa plays a role in hypoxic brain damage.

slots.claim_sentence: Reducing damage from acute hypoxic insults may involve targeting these specific channels.
slots.clarification_sentence: Protecting central neurons is the main goal of these potential therapies.

slots.claim_sentence: Neurons in the brain require a continuous supply of oxygen for normal activity.
slots.clarification_sentence: A lack of oxygen rapidly increases the flow of sodium ions into brain cells.

slots.claim_sentence: Vector-borne disease transmission is predicted to peak at intermediate temperatures.
slots.clarification_sentence: Transmission typically declines at very high and low temperatures.

slots.claim_sentence: The thermal optima and limits for most vector-borne pathogens are currently unknown.
slots.clarification_sentence: Scientists need these specific limits to understand how diseases spread.

slots.claim_sentence: Researchers developed a mechanistic model for the thermal response of Ross River virus.
slots.clarification_sentence: This pathogen is at risk of emerging worldwide from the Pacific Islands.

slots.claim_sentence: Ross River virus transmission peaks at moderate temperatures of 26.4°C.
slots.clarification_sentence: Adult mosquito lifespan largely determines this optimal temperature for transmission.

slots.claim_sentence: Transmission declines to zero at thermal limits of 17.0°C and 31.5°C.
slots.clarification_sentence: The virus stops spreading completely outside of this temperature range.

slots.claim_sentence: The model accurately predicts year-round endemic transmission in tropical areas.
slots.clarification_sentence: Transmission remains seasonal in temperate areas, causing a nationwide peak in cases.

slots.claim_sentence: Climate warming will likely increase transmission in temperate areas where most Australians live.
slots.clarification_sentence: Transmission may decrease in tropical areas already near the thermal optimum.

slots.claim_sentence: These results highlight the importance of using nonlinear models for disease dynamics.
slots.clarification_sentence: Such models help researchers predict how diseases respond to climate change.

slots.claim_sentence: Mosquitoes cannot control their body temperature, so their performance depends on local heat.
slots.clarification_sentence: Outside temperatures affect the spread of diseases transmitted by these insects.

slots.claim_sentence: The behavioral correlates of motor cortical beta oscillations remain unresolved in brain research.
slots.clarification_sentence: Beta oscillations are specific brain waves found in the motor system.

slots.claim_sentence: Researchers recorded multi-scale neural activity from the motor cortex of three macaques.
slots.clarification_sentence: The team used a novel neurofeedback task to study these brain waves.

slots.claim_sentence: Subjects volitionally brought their beta oscillatory power to an instructed state before reaching.
slots.clarification_sentence: The monkeys intentionally increased or decreased their brain wave power on demand.

slots.claim_sentence: A reduction in beta power led to significantly faster movement onset times.
slots.clarification_sentence: Reaches preceded by an increase in beta power were notably slower.

slots.claim_sentence: Population neural activity shifted farther from a movement onset state during beta oscillations.
slots.clarification_sentence: This shift occurred during both neurofeedback-induced and naturally occurring beta oscillations.

slots.claim_sentence: This finding establishes a population neural basis for slowed movement onset.
slots.clarification_sentence: The collective activity of neurons explains why movement starts later after beta activity.

slots.claim_sentence: The patterns of neuron populations moved away from the state needed to start moving.
slots.clarification_sentence: These patterns reflect a common signature of activity across different task contexts.

slots.claim_sentence: Cells generating beta oscillations encode a slower movement state in the motor system.
slots.clarification_sentence: This state may compromise the readiness of the brain for upcoming movements.

slots.claim_sentence: TRAF2 is a protein that helps immune cells regulate their normal functions.
slots.clarification_sentence: This protein is a key part of signaling complexes for the TNF superfamily.

slots.claim_sentence: Mice lacking the TRAF2 protein usually die around the time of birth.
slots.clarification_sentence: This early death makes it difficult to study the protein in adult tissues.

slots.claim_sentence: The specific role of the TRAF2 RING domain remains a controversial topic.
slots.clarification_sentence: Scientists disagree on how this specific part of the protein actually works.

slots.claim_sentence: Some researchers suggested TRAF2 needs a lipid called S1P to function.
slots.clarification_sentence: The enzyme sphingosine kinase 1 produces this lipid to help TRAF2 work.

slots.claim_sentence: Removing Traf2 from skin cells caused severe psoriatic skin inflammation in mice.
slots.clarification_sentence: However, a deficiency in the Sphk1 enzyme did not cause these skin problems.

slots.claim_sentence: The loss of Traf2 disrupted important NF-κB and MAP kinase signaling pathways.
slots.clarification_sentence: This disruption led to the abnormal thickening of the outer skin layer.

slots.claim_sentence: This skin inflammation was driven by TNF and excessive cell death.
slots.clarification_sentence: The adaptive immune system also played a role in driving this disease.

slots.claim_sentence: The mouse model might represent a clinically relevant way to study psoriasis.
slots.clarification_sentence: It shows how non-canonical NF-κB signaling contributes to the inflammatory process.

slots.claim_sentence: TRAF2 has essential functions in specific tissues that are unique from Sphk1.
slots.clarification_sentence: These findings show that the functions of these two proteins do not overlap.

slots.claim_sentence: Glucocorticoids are common drugs, but no biomarker exists to quantify their action.
slots.clarification_sentence: Doctors currently lack a reliable way to measure how these drugs work.

slots.claim_sentence: The study aimed to identify and validate circulating biomarkers of glucocorticoid action.
slots.clarification_sentence: Researchers looked for markers in the blood that track drug activity.

slots.claim_sentence: The study included 10 subjects with primary adrenal insufficiency during drug exposure.
slots.clarification_sentence: These patients do not produce their own glucocorticoids, allowing precise control.

slots.claim_sentence: Integrated multi-omic analysis compared the transcriptome, miRNAomic, and serum metabolomics data.
slots.clarification_sentence: This method combines gene activity and metabolic products for a complete view.

slots.claim_sentence: A transcriptomic profile from two tissues was predictive of glucocorticoid exposure.
slots.clarification_sentence: The profile used gene activity from blood cells and adipose tissue.

slots.claim_sentence: A microRNA called miR-122-5p correlated with glucocorticoid-regulated genes and metabolites.
slots.clarification_sentence: MicroRNAs are small molecules that help control how genes are expressed.

slots.claim_sentence: The identified miR-122-5p was replicated in independent studies with varying exposure.
slots.clarification_sentence: Testing in other groups confirms the molecule is a reliable indicator.

slots.claim_sentence: These results help create biomarkers to individualize and optimize glucocorticoid therapy.
slots.clarification_sentence: Better markers could explain diseases like obesity and cardiovascular disease.

slots.claim_sentence: New biomarkers help doctors tailor drug doses to each patient.
slots.clarification_sentence: Personalized dosing reduces side effects and improves treatment outcomes.

slots.claim_sentence: Dendritic cells take up antigens and route them using C-type lectin receptors.
slots.clarification_sentence: These receptors identify specific sugar structures called glycans on the antigens.

slots.claim_sentence: Modifying the antigen Ovalbumin with the glycan LewisX re-directs it to the receptor MGL1.
slots.clarification_sentence: This modification changes how the immune system processes the protein.

slots.claim_sentence: LewisX-modification of Ovalbumin favored Th1 skewing and enhanced cross-priming of CD8+ T cells.
slots.clarification_sentence: Th1 skewing promotes the development of specific CD4+ T cells.

slots.claim_sentence: LewisX modification reduces the required antigen amount 100-fold for immune activation.
slots.clarification_sentence: The modified antigen also no longer depends on TLR signaling to work.

slots.claim_sentence: The enhanced T cell activation relies specifically on the MGL1 receptor.
slots.clarification_sentence: Mice lacking MGL1 showed reduced frequencies of activated CD8+ effector T cells.

slots.claim_sentence: MGL1-mediated cross-presentation did not require TAP-transporters or the enzyme Cathepsin-S.
slots.clarification_sentence: The antigen remained active even after prolonged storage in specific cellular compartments.

slots.claim_sentence: Controlled neo-glycosylation of antigens can influence the strength of immune responses.
slots.clarification_sentence: This approach could help in optimizing current vaccination strategies for better results.

slots.claim_sentence: Antigen storage occurred in compartments marked by Rab11 and LAMP1 proteins.
slots.clarification_sentence: Extended storage in these compartments provides more time for antigen presentation.

slots.claim_sentence: Burkholderia thailandensis uses quorum sensing systems to regulate hundreds of genes.

slots.claim_sentence: Quorum sensing in B. thailandensis activates cell-cell contact-dependent type VI secretion toxin-immunity systems.
slots.clarification_sentence: The type VI secretion system, or T6S, uses toxins and immunity proteins.

slots.claim_sentence: T6S is required to constrain the proliferation of quorum sensing mutants in colony cocultures.
slots.clarification_sentence: The BtaR1 quorum-sensing signal receptor mutant is one such type of mutant.

slots.claim_sentence: The BtaR1 mutant outcompetes its parent in broth coculture where cell contact is limited.
slots.clarification_sentence: This occurs because quorum sensing gene activation has a high metabolic cost.

slots.claim_sentence: Quorum sensing activates B. thailandensis T6SS-1 growth inhibition to police and constrain mutants.
slots.clarification_sentence: This mechanism ensures that cooperative bacteria can control non-cooperative members of the population.

slots.claim_sentence: This work defines a novel role for T6SSs in intraspecies mutant control.
slots.clarification_sentence: The study reveals how bacteria manage genetic diversity within their own species.

slots.claim_sentence: One specific toxin and immunity pair includes a lipase and an immunity protein.
slots.clarification_sentence: The lipase toxin is encoded by the gene BTH_I2698.

slots.claim_sentence: Cell contact is minimal during growth in broth but occurs on solid surfaces.

slots.claim_sentence: Long-range coupling within prefrontal-hippocampal networks emerges early in life.
slots.clarification_sentence: This early connection is essential for future cognitive performance.

slots.claim_sentence: The cellular substrate of early interactions between these brain regions is unresolved.
slots.clarification_sentence: Researchers do not yet know which specific cells drive these interactions.

slots.claim_sentence: The study used optogenetic manipulation of glutamatergic projection neurons in newborn mice.
slots.clarification_sentence: Scientists targeted the CA1 area of the dorsal or intermediate/ventral hippocampus.

slots.claim_sentence: The prefrontal cortex mainly couples with the intermediate/ventral hippocampus in neonates.
slots.clarification_sentence: This coupling occurs through synchronized neuronal firing and dense direct axonal projections.

slots.claim_sentence: Activating pyramidal neurons in the intermediate/ventral CA1 boosts prefrontal oscillations.
slots.clarification_sentence: Light stimulation of the dorsal CA1 did not produce this same effect.

slots.claim_sentence: The data causally elucidate the cellular origin of coupling in the developing brain.
slots.clarification_sentence: These findings explain how early activity patterns are generated in young circuits.

slots.claim_sentence: The dorsal hippocampus shows stronger theta and ripples power than other regions.
slots.clarification_sentence: The prefrontal cortex still prefers connecting with the intermediate/ventral hippocampus.

slots.claim_sentence: Theta band-confined activation of these neurons specifically increases prefrontal activity.
slots.clarification_sentence: Firing in the hippocampus timed at 8 Hz caused significant augmentation of activity.

slots.claim_sentence: Stimulation at 4 Hz or 16 Hz failed to increase prefrontal power.
slots.clarification_sentence: The observed boost in activity occurred across all frequency bands during stimulation.

slots.claim_sentence: Small molecules called piRNAs are crucial for regulating transposons and other germline genes.
slots.clarification_sentence: These molecules help control gene activity in reproductive cells by silencing harmful genetic elements.

slots.claim_sentence: In Caenorhabditis elegans, the mutator complex regulates piRNA target genes by synthesizing siRNAs.
slots.clarification_sentence: The mutator complex uses an RNA-dependent RNA polymerase to create these secondary small RNAs.

slots.claim_sentence: The specific steps connecting mRNA recognition and siRNA amplification were previously unknown.
slots.clarification_sentence: Researchers did not know how messages traveled between the piRNA pathway and the mutator complex.

slots.claim_sentence: The study identified SIMR-1, a Tudor domain protein, as a key link in this process.
slots.clarification_sentence: SIMR-1 acts after piRNA production but before the mutator complex makes new siRNAs.

slots.claim_sentence: SIMR-1 localizes to distinct subcellular foci near P granules and Mutator foci.
slots.clarification_sentence: These foci are phase-separated condensates where mRNA recognition and siRNA amplification occur.

slots.claim_sentence: Multiple perinuclear condensates organize the piRNA pathway and promote mRNA regulation.
slots.clarification_sentence: This spatial organization helps the mutator complex effectively silence specific genetic targets.

slots.claim_sentence: SIMR-1 forms germline foci near Mutator foci without requiring them for its localization.
slots.clarification_sentence: The localization of Mutator foci is also not dependent on the SIMR-1 protein.

slots.claim_sentence: Proteomic analysis of the protein MUT-16 led to the discovery of SIMR-1.
slots.clarification_sentence: SIMR-1 is required to amplify secondary small RNAs but not to identify target sequences.

slots.claim_sentence: Viruses use host shutoff to stop cells from making their own proteins.
slots.clarification_sentence: This strategy allows viruses to efficiently produce their own viral proteins instead.

slots.claim_sentence: Researchers used RNA-sequencing and ribosome profiling to study the Influenza A virus.
slots.clarification_sentence: These methods helped the team map how the virus causes host shutoff.

slots.claim_sentence: The virus does not give its own genetic instructions special treatment.
slots.clarification_sentence: Instead, the virus takes over the cell by reducing the host mRNA supply.

slots.claim_sentence: The reduction of host genetic instructions varies significantly across different cell transcripts.
slots.clarification_sentence: Short transcripts are less affected by the Influenza A virus during infection.

slots.claim_sentence: Transcripts that resist the virus are often involved in cell maintenance processes.
slots.clarification_sentence: These resistant transcripts include those used for oxidative phosphorylation to produce energy.

slots.claim_sentence: Continuous oxidative phosphorylation activity is important for the virus to spread.
slots.clarification_sentence: The virus relies on this energy production to support its own replication.

slots.claim_sentence: These results advance the understanding of how this virus shuts down cells.
slots.clarification_sentence: The findings suggest a mechanism that protects genes with important housekeeping functions.

slots.claim_sentence: Transcripts with higher GC content also tend to be less affected by infection.
slots.clarification_sentence: The amount of exposed single stranded RNA likely governs the degradation process.

slots.claim_sentence: Protein levels for these energy-related genes remain stable throughout the infection period.
slots.clarification_sentence: The virus potentially depends on these specific pathways for its survival.

slots.claim_sentence: Epsin is an evolutionarily conserved protein that helps cells internalize surface materials.
slots.clarification_sentence: The most critical functions of epsin in clathrin coat dynamics remain elusive.

slots.claim_sentence: Researchers generated embryonic fibroblasts from mice with a conditional triple knockout of epsin.
slots.clarification_sentence: These specific mouse cells were created to completely eliminate all three epsin proteins.

slots.claim_sentence: The epsin triple knockout cells showed a dramatic defect in cell division.
slots.clarification_sentence: This finding suggests that epsin plays a role in fundamental cellular division processes.

slots.claim_sentence: The cells also exhibited a robust impairment in clathrin-mediated endocytosis.
slots.clarification_sentence: This impairment caused an accumulation of early and U-shaped pits on the membrane.

slots.claim_sentence: The endocytosis defect was linked to a perturbation of the clathrin-actin coupling.
slots.clarification_sentence: Researchers confirmed this disrupted connection using a cell-free assay of endocytosis.

slots.claim_sentence: Epsin helps generate the force for the invagination and fission of pits.
slots.clarification_sentence: The protein also maintains a low affinity interaction with SNARE proteins.

slots.claim_sentence: Epsin provides a necessary link between the clathrin coat and the actin cytoskeleton.
slots.clarification_sentence: This link allows pits to transition from a shallow to a deeply invaginated state.

slots.claim_sentence: Force generation is a key evolutionary conserved function of the epsin protein family.
slots.clarification_sentence: This force is required for clathrin-coated pits to pinch off into vesicles.

slots.claim_sentence: Interactions between three pigment cell types are required to form the stripe pattern of adult zebrafish.
slots.clarification_sentence: These three types of cells must work together to create the characteristic horizontal stripes.

slots.claim_sentence: Mutations in the leopard (leo) gene cause spotted patterns in zebrafish instead of stripes.
slots.clarification_sentence: The leopard gene encodes Connexin 41.8 (Cx41.8), which is a gap junction subunit.

slots.claim_sentence: A new dominant allele called leotK3 causes a complete loss of the pattern in zebrafish.
slots.clarification_sentence: This specific mutation has a dominant negative impact on other components of gap junctions.

slots.claim_sentence: A genetic screen identified Connexin 39.4 (Cx39.4), also known as luchs, as a junction component.
slots.clarification_sentence: The luchs protein works alongside the leopard protein to form channels for cell communication.

slots.claim_sentence: Loss-of-function alleles of luchs are required for stripe formation in zebrafish bodies.
slots.clarification_sentence: While the body pattern is disrupted, the fins of these fish are almost not affected.

slots.claim_sentence: Both Cx41.8 (leo) and Cx39.4 (luchs) proteins form heteromeric gap junctions together.
slots.clarification_sentence: These junctions are only required in yellow xanthophores and black melanophores, not in iridophores.

slots.claim_sentence: These heteromeric gap junctions promote homotypic interactions between melanophores and xanthophores.
slots.clarification_sentence: These specific cell interactions then instruct the patterning of the third cell type, the iridophores.

slots.claim_sentence: The global malaria burden has decreased over the last decade and many nations are attempting elimination.
slots.clarification_sentence: Many countries now aim to completely banish the disease within their borders.

slots.claim_sentence: Asymptomatic malaria infections are not normally diagnosed or treated, posing a major hurdle for elimination efforts.
slots.clarification_sentence: People with asymptomatic malaria do not show symptoms but can still spread the parasite.

slots.claim_sentence: Mass drug administration (MDA) is one solution, with success depending on adequate population participation.
slots.clarification_sentence: This method involves giving antimalarial drugs to everyone in a community at once.

slots.claim_sentence: Researchers conducted a spatial and temporal analysis of malaria in four villages in Kayin State, Myanmar.
slots.clarification_sentence: The study tracked malaria episodes and asymptomatic infections in villages undergoing mass drug administration.

slots.claim_sentence: Individuals from neighborhoods with low MDA adherence had 2.85 times the odds of having a malaria episode.
slots.clarification_sentence: This increased risk occurred regardless of whether the specific individual participated in the drug program.

slots.claim_sentence: This study provides the first documentation of a herd effect for Plasmodium falciparum malaria.
slots.clarification_sentence: A herd effect means high community participation protects even those who did not take the medicine.

slots.claim_sentence: High mosquito biting rates and living with someone with malaria were also predictors of clinical episodes.
slots.clarification_sentence: Having an asymptomatic malaria infection also predicted whether a person would develop a clinical episode.

slots.claim_sentence: Spatial clustering of non-adherence to MDA may frustrate elimination efforts even with high overall participation.
slots.clarification_sentence: Small groups of people who do not participate can allow the disease to persist locally.

slots.claim_sentence: There is a lack of models to investigate this interaction during human embryogenesis.

slots.clarification_sentence: This separation occurred as the heart cells began their first contractions.

slots.clarification_sentence: It provides a way to study tissue boundary formation during embryogenesis.

slots.claim_sentence: Most changes in an organism's DNA negatively impact fitness.
slots.clarification_sentence: While mutations allow organisms to adapt to stressful environments, random changes are rarely beneficial.

slots.claim_sentence: The mutation rate is strictly regulated and often considered a slowly-evolving parameter.
slots.clarification_sentence: Cells must balance the need for new mutations against the risk of genetic damage.

slots.claim_sentence: This study demonstrates an unexpected flexibility in cellular mutation rates during selective pressure.
slots.clarification_sentence: The researchers found that these rates change quickly to help avoid extinction under stress.

slots.claim_sentence: Hypermutation independently evolves when different Escherichia coli cultures adapt to high ethanol stress.
slots.clarification_sentence: Escherichia coli is a common bacterium used here to model how cells handle severe stress.

slots.claim_sentence: Hypermutator states are transitory and repeatedly alternate with decreases in mutation rate.
slots.clarification_sentence: These temporary states allow for rapid changes before the rate drops back down.

slots.claim_sentence: Population mutation rates rise during higher stress and decline once cells are adapted.
slots.clarification_sentence: High mutation rates become harmful once the bacteria have successfully adjusted to the environment.

slots.claim_sentence: Cellular mortality is the major force driving the quick evolution of mutation rates.
slots.clarification_sentence: The death of cells acts as a primary signal to change how fast mutations occur.

slots.claim_sentence: These findings show how organisms balance robustness and evolvability in various settings.
slots.clarification_sentence: This balance helps explain antibiotic resistance in microbes and cancer relapses after chemotherapy.

slots.claim_sentence: The SnRK1 kinases are conserved metabolic regulators that respond to low energy in plants.
slots.clarification_sentence: These kinases are activated during starvation to help organisms survive stress.

slots.claim_sentence: These kinases control metabolic enzymes and perform extensive transcriptional reprogramming.
slots.clarification_sentence: Transcriptional reprogramming involves changing how genes are expressed in the cell.

slots.claim_sentence: The way these kinases reprogram gene expression is unknown in plants.
slots.clarification_sentence: Scientists did not know which proteins help the kinases control these genes.

slots.claim_sentence: Researchers identified the Arabidopsis transcription factor bZIP63 as a target of SnRK1.
slots.clarification_sentence: The bZIP63 protein acts as a key regulator of the plant starvation response.

slots.claim_sentence: SnRK1 phosphorylation of bZIP63 altered how the protein pairs with others.
slots.clarification_sentence: This change in pairing affects target gene expression and primary metabolism.

slots.claim_sentence: A bzip63 knock-out mutant plant showed several starvation-related phenotypes.
slots.clarification_sentence: Normal bZIP63 fixed these issues but a mutated version did not.

slots.claim_sentence: The pairing of bZIP63 is influenced by modifications like phosphorylation.
slots.clarification_sentence: Phosphorylation is a chemical change that controls how proteins function.

slots.claim_sentence: Phosphorylation at specific SnRK1 target sites is essential for bZIP63 function.
slots.clarification_sentence: Without these sites, the plant cannot respond correctly to low energy.

slots.claim_sentence: The kinases turn on pathways for alternative energy production to survive.
slots.clarification_sentence: These pathways slow down processes that consume too much energy.

slots.claim_sentence: Ternatin is a natural product that kills cells and prevents fat formation.
slots.clarification_sentence: The molecular mode of action for this compound was previously unknown.

slots.claim_sentence: New synthetic ternatin variants are cytotoxic toward cancer cells.
slots.clarification_sentence: These variants show up to 500-fold greater potency than ternatin itself.

slots.claim_sentence: The translation elongation factor-1A ternary complex is a specific target of ternatin.
slots.clarification_sentence: This complex includes the eEF1A protein, GTP, and aminoacyl-tRNA molecules.

slots.claim_sentence: Unrelated natural products like didemnin and cytotrienin also bind to this complex.
slots.clarification_sentence: These different compounds show competitive binding at the same molecular site.

slots.claim_sentence: Mutations in domain III of eEF1A prevent ternatin from binding.
slots.clarification_sentence: These specific changes confer resistance to the cytotoxic effects of the drug.

slots.claim_sentence: The adjacent hydrophobic surface is a functional hot spot for eEF1A modulation.
slots.clarification_sentence: This surface allows molecules to interact with and change the protein function.

slots.claim_sentence: The eEF1A ternary complex is a common target for cytotoxic natural products.
slots.clarification_sentence: Many different cell-killing compounds have evolved to target this specific protein machinery.

slots.claim_sentence: A ternatin photo-affinity probe helped identify the specific protein target.
slots.clarification_sentence: The probe crosslinked to the purified protein only within its ternary complex.

slots.claim_sentence: Potent variants require a smaller dose to achieve the same effect.
slots.clarification_sentence: Lower doses of the compound are still able to kill cancer cells.

slots.claim_sentence: Mutations in the inositol 5-phosphatase OCRL cause Lowe syndrome and Dent's disease.
slots.clarification_sentence: OCRL is a protein that modifies a specific membrane lipid.

slots.claim_sentence: OCRL loss in Lowe syndrome patient fibroblasts impacts clathrin-mediated endocytosis.
slots.clarification_sentence: Endocytosis is a process where cells transport molecules into themselves.

slots.claim_sentence: Lowe syndrome patient cells exhibit an accumulation of clathrin-coated vesicles.
slots.clarification_sentence: Clathrin forms a basket-like coat around vesicles during endocytosis.

slots.claim_sentence: Endocytic vesicles that fail to lose their coat nucleate many actin comets.
slots.clarification_sentence: Actin comets are structures associated with cell movement and transport.

slots.claim_sentence: The adaptor SNX9 binds OCRL directly at late-stage endocytic coated pits.
slots.clarification_sentence: SNX9 is an adaptor protein involved in endocytosis.

slots.claim_sentence: OCRL acts as an uncoating factor during the endocytosis process.
slots.clarification_sentence: An uncoating factor helps remove the clathrin coat from vesicles.

slots.claim_sentence: SNX9 couples late-stage endocytic coated pits to actin polymerization.
slots.clarification_sentence: This coupling is essential for the normal movement of vesicles.

slots.claim_sentence: The increase in coated pits may result from trapped coat components.
slots.clarification_sentence: These components are sequestered on vesicles that cannot uncoat properly.

slots.claim_sentence: Defects in clathrin-mediated endocytosis likely contribute to pathology in patients.
slots.clarification_sentence: OCRL facilitates the recycling of endocytic factors for normal cell function.

slots.claim_sentence: Patient cells also show an increase in U-shaped clathrin-coated pits.
slots.clarification_sentence: Electron microscopy confirmed the robust increase in coated vesicles.

slots.claim_sentence: Uncontrolled activation of Wnt/β-catenin signaling is a major cause of colorectal cancer.
slots.clarification_sentence: Finding effective Wnt inhibitors to treat this cancer remains a difficult challenge.

slots.claim_sentence: New insights into Wnt/β-catenin pathway regulation are needed to find therapeutic targets.
slots.clarification_sentence: Understanding these control mechanisms could reveal new ways to intervene in cancer.

slots.claim_sentence: The proteins FAK and PYK2 are elevated in human colorectal cancer tissues.
slots.clarification_sentence: These two proteins work together to promote the Wnt/β-catenin signaling pathway.

slots.claim_sentence: FAK and PYK2 activate the pathway by phosphorylating the protein GSK3βY216.
slots.clarification_sentence: This modification leads to β-catenin accumulation and intestinal tumor growth in mice.

slots.claim_sentence: Phosphorylation of GSK3βY216 allows the protein to recruit another factor called β-TrCP.
slots.clarification_sentence: This specific recruitment is required for the accumulation of β-catenin in cells.

slots.claim_sentence: Pharmacological inhibition of FAK and PYK2 suppressed adenoma formation in APCmin/+ mice.
slots.clarification_sentence: The drug treatment reduced the levels of phospho-GSK3βY216 and β-catenin in the intestine.

slots.claim_sentence: The FAK/PYK2/GSK3βY216 axis is critical for Wnt/β-catenin activation in intestinal cancer.
slots.clarification_sentence: This axis drives tumorigenesis when the APC gene is mutated in the gut.

slots.claim_sentence: The study identified a novel regulatory axis involving FAK and PYK2 proteins.
slots.clarification_sentence: These proteins are also elevated in adenomas found in APCmin/+ mice.

slots.claim_sentence: Phosphorylation of GSK3βY216 by FAK and PYK2 determines GSK3β recruitment of β-TrCP.
slots.clarification_sentence: GSK3β is a protein that normally switches the Wnt pathway off.

slots.claim_sentence: The transcription factor RpaA is the master regulator of circadian transcription in cyanobacteria.
slots.clarification_sentence: This protein controls how genes follow a daily rhythm in these bacteria.

slots.claim_sentence: Deletion of rpaA renders cyanobacteria inviable in cycling light and dark conditions.
slots.clarification_sentence: The rpaA- strain rapidly loses viability when incubated in the dark.

slots.claim_sentence: The rpaA- strain cannot maintain appropriate energy status at night.
slots.clarification_sentence: These cells do not accumulate carbon reserves during the day.

slots.claim_sentence: The rpaA- strain is defective in transcription of genes for carbohydrate stores.
slots.clarification_sentence: This defect prevents the utilization of carbohydrate stores at night.

slots.claim_sentence: Reconstruction of carbon utilization pathways restores viability of the rpaA- strain.
slots.clarification_sentence: Providing an external carbon source also helps restore the energy charge.

slots.claim_sentence: Restoring these pathways allows survival in light and dark cycling conditions.
slots.clarification_sentence: The introduction of a glucose transporter rescued the viability defect.

slots.claim_sentence: A circadian output pathway controls and coordinates carbon metabolism.
slots.clarification_sentence: This coordination helps maximize fitness in cells facing periodic energy limitations.

slots.claim_sentence: The core oscillator prepares cells for the metabolic demands of darkness.
slots.clarification_sentence: Regulation of RpaA activity is the primary way this timing occurs.

slots.claim_sentence: RpaA drives genome-wide oscillations in the abundance of messenger RNA.
slots.clarification_sentence: Messenger RNA levels change rhythmically across the entire genome.

slots.claim_sentence: AAA+ chaperones are protein machines that use energy to unfold other proteins.
slots.clarification_sentence: These machines pull proteins through a central pore using energy from ATP.

slots.claim_sentence: The unfolding activity of these machines can be harmful to cells.
slots.clarification_sentence: Cells require tight repression to prevent the machines from destroying essential proteins.

slots.claim_sentence: The AAA+ chaperone ClpC works with a peptidase called ClpP.
slots.clarification_sentence: This bacterial protease is essential for stress resistance and causing disease.

slots.claim_sentence: Researchers used cryo-EM structures to see how ClpC is repressed.
slots.clarification_sentence: They compared the ground state of ClpC with and without MecA.

slots.claim_sentence: Inactive ClpC forms large assemblies made of two intertwined helices.
slots.clarification_sentence: These helices connect through head-to-head contacts between coiled-coil middle domains.

slots.claim_sentence: The activator MecA converts this resting state into an active ring.
slots.clarification_sentence: MecA binds to the middle domain sites to trigger this structural change.

slots.claim_sentence: Mutations in the middle domains cause ClpC to stay constantly active.
slots.clarification_sentence: This loss of ClpC repression leads to severe cellular toxicity.

slots.claim_sentence: These findings reveal an unexpected regulatory concept for AAA+ chaperone activity.
slots.clarification_sentence: Coiled-coil middle domains act as key devices to tightly control these machines.

slots.claim_sentence: The activator protein changes the helical assembly into a flat ring structure.
slots.clarification_sentence: Binding occurs at the sites where head-to-head interactions normally happen.

slots.claim_sentence: The substantia nigra pars reticulata contains GABAergic neurons that are spontaneously active.
slots.clarification_sentence: These SNr neurons provide tonic inhibition to other brain areas.

slots.claim_sentence: A depolarizing 'leak' current supports the spontaneous firing pattern of SNr neurons.
slots.clarification_sentence: The molecular basis of this specific current is currently poorly understood.

slots.claim_sentence: Researchers used single-cell RNA sequencing to determine the transcriptome of mouse SNr neurons.
slots.clarification_sentence: This method helps identify genes that maintain tonic activity in individual cells.

slots.claim_sentence: The study discovered that SNr neurons express the sodium leak channel called NALCN.
slots.clarification_sentence: SNr neurons lacking NALCN show impaired spontaneous firing compared to normal cells.

slots.claim_sentence: NALCN is involved in the modulation of excitability by changes in glycolysis.
slots.clarification_sentence: The channel also responds to the activation of muscarinic acetylcholine receptors.

slots.claim_sentence: Disruption of NALCN could impair the basal ganglia circuit in the brain.

slots.claim_sentence: Tuberculous meningitis is a brain infection with high mortality linked to excessive inflammation.
slots.clarification_sentence: This severe condition involves swelling of the lining around the brain.

slots.claim_sentence: Adjunctive anti-inflammatory corticosteroids reduce mortality in this disease by only 30%.
slots.clarification_sentence: This limited success suggests that inflammation causes only some of the deaths.

slots.claim_sentence: A Vietnam study showed corticosteroid survival benefits were strongest with a specific LTA4H gene variant.
slots.clarification_sentence: The LTA4H gene helps regulate the balance of inflammatory signals in the body.

slots.claim_sentence: Patients with the LTA4H TT genotype had increased survival when treated with these drugs.
slots.clarification_sentence: The TT genotype leads to higher gene expression and hyper-inflammatory responses.

slots.claim_sentence: However, a study in Indonesia did not find this LTA4H TT genotype survival benefit.
slots.clarification_sentence: This difference between the two studies created a puzzle for researchers.

slots.claim_sentence: New Bayesian methods show the LTA4H TT genotype confers survival benefit in both populations.
slots.clarification_sentence: This benefit begins early and continues long-term for patients in both countries.

slots.claim_sentence: The survival benefit is nullified in the most severe cases with high early mortality.
slots.clarification_sentence: Extreme disease severity may override the advantages provided by the specific genotype.

slots.claim_sentence: LTA4H genotyping and disease severity assessment may target therapy to patients who benefit most.
slots.clarification_sentence: This approach helps doctors avoid giving drugs to those unlikely to see clinical gains.

slots.claim_sentence: The roles of chance, contingency, and necessity in evolution remain unresolved.
slots.clarification_sentence: These factors have never been assessed together in a single system.

slots.claim_sentence: Researchers used ancestral protein reconstruction and a new continuous evolution technology.
slots.clarification_sentence: They studied how B-cell lymphoma-2 proteins acquire new interaction specificities.

slots.claim_sentence: Contingency over long historical timescales erased necessity and overwhelmed chance.
slots.clarification_sentence: This contingency was the primary cause of acquired sequence variation.

slots.claim_sentence: Distant proteins yielded no common mutations under identical selection pressures.
slots.clarification_sentence: Strong selection did not force proteins toward the same genetic outcomes.

slots.claim_sentence: Chance arose because many sets of mutations could alter specificity.
slots.clarification_sentence: Multiple paths to a selected phenotype were accessible at any timepoint.

slots.claim_sentence: Contingency arose because historical substitutions changed these available mutation sets.
slots.clarification_sentence: Past changes made later mutations either harmful or functionally inconsequential.

slots.claim_sentence: Patterns of variation in BCL-2 sequences are idiosyncratic products of history.
slots.clarification_sentence: These sequences result from a particular and unpredictable course of events.

slots.claim_sentence: Qualitatively similar results may apply to many other proteins as well.
slots.clarification_sentence: Sequence evolution in many families is likely shaped by contingent constraints.

slots.claim_sentence: Replicating evolutionary trajectories from multiple ancestral proteins revealed these patterns.
slots.clarification_sentence: Outcomes were different among trajectories initiated from historical starting points.

slots.claim_sentence: Early development of many animals involves rapid cleavages that dramatically decrease cell size.
slots.clarification_sentence: Scientists do not fully understand how the mitotic spindle adapts to these changing cell dimensions.

slots.claim_sentence: Researchers established an in vitro system using cytoplasmic extracts from Xenopus laevis embryos.
slots.clarification_sentence: This system recapitulates in vivo spindle size differences between stage 3 and stage 8 embryos.

slots.claim_sentence: Stage 3 embryos have 4 cells measuring 37 micrometers in spindle length.
slots.clarification_sentence: Stage 8 embryos contain about 4000 cells with spindles measuring 18 micrometers.

slots.claim_sentence: The kinesin-13 kif2a was identified as a driver of developmental spindle scaling.
slots.clarification_sentence: The protein kif2a possesses microtubule-destabilizing activity that helps control spindle size.

slots.claim_sentence: The transport receptor importin alpha inhibits kif2a activity in stage 3 spindles.
slots.clarification_sentence: In stage 8, importin alpha partitions to a membrane pool to activate kif2a.

slots.claim_sentence: Altering spindle size in developing embryos impaired spindle orientation during metaphase.
slots.clarification_sentence: Despite these orientation issues, chromosome segregation remained robust during cell division.

slots.claim_sentence: A large spindle is not essential for the division of large cells.
slots.clarification_sentence: The architecture of the spindle remained viable even when its size was decreased.

slots.claim_sentence: Spindle size in Xenopus development is coupled to cell size through a ratiometric mechanism.
slots.clarification_sentence: This mechanism coordinates spindle size by controlling the destabilization of microtubules.

slots.claim_sentence: Riboswitch aptamers are RNA parts that can form tandem arrangements to act as logic gates.
slots.clarification_sentence: These two-input Boolean logic gates allow the RNA to process multiple chemical signals at once.

slots.claim_sentence: Researchers discovered riboswitch aptamers that detect a molecule called phosphoribosyl pyrophosphate or PRPP.
slots.clarification_sentence: These PRPP sensors exist alone or in tandem with other sensors called guanine aptamers.

slots.claim_sentence: Tandem guanine-PRPP aptamers bind these two target ligands to approximate an IMPLY Boolean logic gate.
slots.clarification_sentence: This logic gate helps regulate transcription of messenger RNAs for de novo purine biosynthesis in bacteria.

slots.claim_sentence: The tandem arrangement allows bacteria to tune gene expression based on guanine and PRPP levels.
slots.clarification_sentence: Purines are essential building blocks that the cell must produce to create new RNA molecules.

slots.claim_sentence: These all-RNA regulatory systems sense ancient derivatives to control the synthesis of new RNA molecules.
slots.clarification_sentence: This finding supports the hypothesis that RNA World organisms managed a complex metabolic state.

slots.claim_sentence: Early life forms likely performed sophisticated decision-making without the assistance of protein regulatory factors.
slots.clarification_sentence: The discovery shows how RNA alone can monitor metabolites and regulate biological functions in cells.

slots.claim_sentence: The guanine-PRPP tandem riboswitch arrangement activates or shuts down protein production in response to both chemicals.
slots.clarification_sentence: The system responds to the relative concentrations of guanine and PRPP to control gene expression.

slots.claim_sentence: The HIV-1 Gag protein selects and packages a dimeric, unspliced viral RNA.
slots.clarification_sentence: This selection occurs even when there is a large excess of human RNAs.

slots.claim_sentence: Gag assembles on the plasma membrane to enrich the viral genome.
slots.clarification_sentence: The exact mechanism for this enrichment was previously unknown to researchers.

slots.claim_sentence: Researchers used a minimal system with purified RNAs and recombinant HIV-1 Gag.
slots.clarification_sentence: The system used giant unilamellar vesicles to replicate selective packaging.

slots.claim_sentence: Mutations in the CA-CTD domain of Gag abolished its RNA selectivity.
slots.clarification_sentence: These specific mutations subtly affect how the Gag proteins self-assemble.

slots.claim_sentence: The molecule tRNA suppresses Gag membrane binding less when viral RNA is bound.
slots.clarification_sentence: This allows Gag to associate with the membrane more effectively.

slots.claim_sentence: Selective RNA packaging and Gag self-assembly on membranes are interdependent.
slots.clarification_sentence: The ability to form clusters is crucial for choosing the viral genome.

slots.claim_sentence: The study focused on the 5’ untranslated region of the HIV-1 genome.
slots.clarification_sentence: This region is essential for the selective packaging of the viral RNA.

slots.claim_sentence: Lattice contacts that allow Gag to multimerize are vital for RNA selection.
slots.clarification_sentence: Altering these contacts decreases selectivity without affecting non-specific RNA binding.

slots.claim_sentence: Infected cells contain many human RNA molecules that do not contain virus genes.
slots.clarification_sentence: The virus must ensure that new particles only contain viral RNA.

slots.claim_sentence: The role of RNA 3′-end processing in regulatory variation is largely unknown.
slots.clarification_sentence: Identifying functional elements in 3′ untranslated regions remains a significant challenge.

slots.claim_sentence: The study conducted a genomic survey of transcript ends in lymphoblastoid cells.
slots.clarification_sentence: These immune cells were collected from genetically distinct human individuals.

slots.claim_sentence: Transcript end positions were not random in untranslated regions.
slots.clarification_sentence: These positions preferentially flanked 3′ regulatory elements, including miRNA sites.

slots.claim_sentence: Polymorphisms in polyadenylation signals significantly predicted expression levels of their respective genes.
slots.clarification_sentence: The usage of these transcript length forms varied across human individuals.

slots.claim_sentence: Independent single-gene experiments confirmed the effects of polyadenylation variants on steady-state expression.
slots.clarification_sentence: These tests validated 3′ cis-regulatory sequence elements that mediated RNA length forms.

slots.claim_sentence: The study established the effect of natural variation on the response to antigen stimulation.
slots.clarification_sentence: This analysis focused specifically on the immune regulator IRF5.

slots.claim_sentence: The results emphasize two mechanisms in the genetics of 3′-end variation.
slots.clarification_sentence: These include distinct 3′-end processing signals and sequence elements that determine transcript fate.

slots.claim_sentence: Integrating observed 3′-end positions with inferred 3′ regulatory motifs will be a critical tool.
slots.clarification_sentence: This strategy helps researchers interpret human genome variation more accurately.

slots.claim_sentence: The study explores a framework to model allosteric multisite phosphorylation proteins using a single auxiliary variable.
slots.clarification_sentence: This approach is called modified fraction modeling and simplifies complex biological systems.

slots.claim_sentence: This reduction can closely replicate the steady state behavior of detailed multisite systems.
slots.clarification_sentence: The model matches results from the complex Monod-Wyman-Changeux allosteric model or rule-based models.

slots.claim_sentence: Optimal ultrasensitivity in an allosteric protein is achieved when activation by individual sites is concerted and redundant.
slots.clarification_sentence: This means multiple sites must change together, but not all sites are required for full activation.

slots.claim_sentence: The reduction in complexity makes this framework useful for modeling and analyzing biochemical systems in practical applications.
slots.clarification_sentence: It allows researchers to study cases where several multisite proteins interact simultaneously.

slots.claim_sentence: As an application, the study analyzes a newly discovered checkpoint signaling pathway in budding yeast.
slots.clarification_sentence: This pathway is proposed to measure cell growth by monitoring signals from plasma membrane growth.

slots.claim_sentence: The known components of this pathway in budding yeast can form a robust hysteretic switch.
slots.clarification_sentence: A hysteretic switch allows the system to maintain a stable state even if input signals change.

slots.claim_sentence: The system incorporates a signal proportional to bud growth and an all-or-none response.
slots.clarification_sentence: This response is triggered only when the signal reaches a threshold indicating that sufficient growth has occurred.
